blocks.text: This verse speaks of the One Universal Creator God. It emphasizes that The Name Is Truth, and there is No Fear.
The verse describes the nature of the Divine as self-existent and beyond birth. It affirms truth in the beginning, throughout the ages, and forever.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling anxious about an upcoming presentation. Do you:

choices.text: Remember the One Creator and focus on truth and fearlessness.
Let the anxiety consume you and avoid preparing.

blocks.why: Remembering truth and fearlessness can help manage anxiety. These tags are about remembering the divine.

blocks.question: What qualities are emphasized in this verse?

blocks.text: Reflecting on the One Creator and truth can bring peace.
This passage discusses the limits of human effort to find truth. It emphasizes obeying the Hukam (Command) of the Divine Will.
The verses state that truth cannot be found through thinking, silence, or worldly possessions. Understanding and obeying the Divine Command is the way to truth, and to shed ego.

blocks.scenario: You are frustrated because your plans keep getting disrupted. Do you:

choices.text: Try to accept the disruptions as part of the Divine Command.
Become angry and try to force your original plans.

blocks.why: Accepting the Divine Command can bring peace amidst disruptions. These tags are about accepting the divine will.

blocks.question: According to this passage, how can one become truthful?
blocks.answer: By obeying the Hukam of His Command.

blocks.text: Understanding and accepting the Divine Command can lead to truth.
This section speaks of the True Master and the importance of Naam (Name). It highlights the significance of love and grace.
The verses emphasize chanting the True Name with infinite love, especially before dawn. Liberation is found through His Grace. The True One is All.

blocks.scenario: You want to feel closer to the Divine. Do you:

choices.text: Chant the True Name with love and contemplate His greatness.
Focus on material possessions and ignore spiritual practices.

blocks.why: Chanting the True Name with love can bring you closer to the Divine. These tags are about love and the divine name.

blocks.question: What is the significance of chanting the True Name?
blocks.answer: It evokes His Love and allows contemplation of His Greatness.

blocks.text: Chanting the True Name with love can bring you closer to the Divine.
This passage emphasizes the importance of listening and the power of Divine Grace. It speaks of the bliss of devotees.
The verses state that listening can lead to bliss and erase pain and sin. God blesses the unworthy with virtue and bestows virtue on the virtuous.

blocks.scenario: You feel overwhelmed by negative thoughts. Do you:

choices.text: Listen to teachings and try to focus on the Divine.
Give in to the negative thoughts and isolate yourself.

blocks.why: Listening to teachings can help erase pain and sin. These tags are about compassion and divine grace.

blocks.question: What are the benefits of listening, according to this passage?
blocks.answer: Listening can erase pain and sin.

blocks.text: Listening and focusing on the Divine can bring bliss and erase negativity.
This section highlights the benefits of listening to truth and spiritual wisdom. It speaks of the indescribable state of the faithful.
The verses state that listening brings truth, contentment, and spiritual wisdom. The state of the faithful is beyond description; it can only be known through faith.

blocks.scenario: You are seeking inner peace. Do you:

choices.text: Listen to teachings and seek truth, contentment, and spiritual wisdom.
Chase after material possessions and ignore spiritual growth.

blocks.why: Listening to teachings can bring truth and contentment. These tags are about truth and spiritual wisdom.

blocks.question: What does listening bring, according to this passage?

blocks.text: Listening to truth and seeking spiritual wisdom can lead to inner peace.
This passage describes the qualities and benefits of the faithful. It emphasizes their connection to Dharma (righteousness).
The verses state that the faithful have awareness, intelligence, and are bound to Dharma. They are liberated and do not wander around begging.

blocks.scenario: You are facing a difficult moral decision. Do you:

choices.text: Seek guidance from Dharma and act with righteousness.
Choose the option that benefits you the most, regardless of ethics.

blocks.why: The faithful are firmly bound to Dharma. These tags are about righteousness and fearlessness.

blocks.question: What are the characteristics of the faithful, according to this passage?
blocks.answer: Awareness, intelligence, and adherence to Dharma.

blocks.text: Connecting to Dharma and acting with righteousness can lead to liberation.
This section speaks of the chosen ones and the vastness of creation. It emphasizes that whatever pleases the Divine is good.
The verses state that Dharma is the son of compassion. The universe was created with One Word. Whatever pleases the Divine is the only good done.

blocks.scenario: You are unsure about the right course of action. Do you:

choices.text: Reflect on what would please the Divine and act accordingly.
Follow your own desires without considering the Divine will.

blocks.why: Whatever pleases the Divine is the only good done. These tags are about compassion and the divine will.

blocks.question: According to this passage, what is Dharma?

blocks.text: Seeking to please the Divine can guide you to the right course of action.
This passage speaks of the power of the Word and the importance of Naam. It emphasizes that all virtues are from the Divine.
The verses state that the universe is a manifestation of the Divine Name. Actions determine destiny, and we come and go by the Hukam of God's Command. All virtues are Yours, Lord.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling proud of your accomplishments. Do you:

choices.text: Remember that all virtues are from the Divine and remain humble.
Take all the credit for yourself and become arrogant.

blocks.why: All virtues are Yours, Lord. These tags are about divine grace and the divine name.

blocks.question: According to this passage, what determines our destiny?

blocks.text: Remembering that all virtues are from the Divine can help you remain humble.
This lesson explores the vastness of the universe and the greatness of the One who knows Himself. We will contemplate the endlessness of His gifts and the limits of human understanding.

The scriptures describe countless worlds, but in reality, there is only One Universe. It is impossible to fully describe the greatness of the Divine. Only He Himself knows Himself, and He bestows His blessings by His Glance of Grace.

blocks.scenario: You are looking at the night sky, filled with stars. Do you feel A) overwhelmed by the sheer size and mystery, or B) like you can understand it all?

choices.text: Overwhelmed by the mystery
Like you understand it all

blocks.why: The lesson emphasizes the limits of human understanding in the face of the Divine and the vastness of creation, aligning with the feeling of being overwhelmed.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, who truly knows the greatness of the Divine?

blocks.text: Reflect on the greatness of the Divine and the endlessness of His gifts.

This lesson focuses on gratitude for the Divine gifts and the understanding that everything happens by His Will. We will explore the abundance of His blessings and the importance of acknowledging His role in all things.

His blessings are abundant, and He gives without holding back. Even those who suffer receive His gifts, though it may not seem so. Liberation comes only by His Will, and He Himself knows and gives, though few acknowledge this.

blocks.scenario: You receive an unexpected gift. Do you A) acknowledge the giver and feel grateful, or B) simply accept it without much thought?

choices.text: Acknowledge the giver and feel grateful
Accept it without much thought

blocks.why: The lesson emphasizes acknowledging the giver and being grateful for the gifts received, aligning with actively recognizing the source of blessings.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, how does liberation from bondage come?

blocks.text: Remember to be grateful for all the gifts you receive, knowing they come from the Divine.
This lesson explores the path of humility, compassion, and the recognition of the One. We will contemplate the brotherhood of all mankind and the Divine's presence throughout all ages.

See the brotherhood of all mankind; conquer your own mind. The Primal One is without beginning, without end, and is the same throughout all ages. Let compassion be your attendant, and recognize that union and separation come by His Will.

blocks.scenario: You see someone struggling. Do you A) offer help and compassion, or B) ignore them and continue with your day?

choices.text: Offer help and compassion
Ignore them and continue with your day

blocks.why: The lesson emphasizes compassion as an attendant, aligning with offering help and support to those in need.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, what should you see as the highest order?

blocks.text: Strive to cultivate humility and compassion in your daily life, recognizing the oneness of all.
This lesson focuses on the truth of creation and the limits of human power. We will contemplate the True Lord's creation and the understanding that He alone has the Power.
True is the Creation of the True Lord. We have no power to speak, to be silent, to give, or to live. He alone has the Power in His Hands, and He watches over all. No one is high or low.

blocks.scenario: You feel powerless in a situation. Do you A) accept that you are not in control and trust in a higher power, or B) try to force your will upon the situation?

choices.text: Accept that you are not in control and trust in a higher power
Try to force your will upon the situation

blocks.why: The lesson emphasizes the lack of human power and the importance of recognizing that He alone has the Power, aligning with trusting in a higher power.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, who has the Power in His Hands?

blocks.text: Remember that the True Lord's creation is true, and He alone has the power.
This lesson explores the realms of Dharma and wisdom. We will contemplate righteous living, spiritual wisdom, and the indescribable beauty of the Divine.

By our deeds and actions, we shall be judged in the True Court. In the realm of wisdom, spiritual wisdom reigns supreme. The forms of incomparable beauty in the realm of humility cannot be described, and His limit has no limit.

blocks.scenario: You are faced with a difficult decision. Do you A) choose the path of righteous living and spiritual wisdom, or B) choose the path that is easiest and most convenient?

choices.text: Choose the path of righteous living and spiritual wisdom
Choose the path that is easiest and most convenient

blocks.why: The lesson emphasizes righteous living and spiritual wisdom, aligning with choosing the path that reflects these values.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, what reigns supreme in the realm of wisdom?

blocks.text: Strive to live righteously and seek spiritual wisdom, recognizing the indescribable beauty of the Divine.
This lesson explores the power of the Word and the importance of being imbued with the Lord's Essence. We will contemplate the realm of karma and the realm of Truth.

In the realm of karma, the Word is Power. Those who dwell there are totally fulfilled, imbued with the Lord's Essence. Having created the creation, He watches over it and bestows happiness. As He commands, so they exist.

blocks.scenario: You are performing an act of service. Do you A) focus on the task and feel connected to something greater, or B) simply go through the motions without much thought?

choices.text: Focus on the task and feel connected to something greater
Simply go through the motions without much thought

blocks.why: The lesson emphasizes being imbued with the Lord's Essence, aligning with feeling connected to something greater while performing seva.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, what is the power in the realm of karma?

blocks.text: Strive to be imbued with the Lord's Essence and recognize the power of the Word in your life.
This lesson explores the True Lord's creation and the variety of Maya. We will contemplate His greatness and the importance of pleasing to His Will.

The True Lord is True, forever True, and True is His Name. He created the world, with its various colors, species of beings, and the variety of Maya. They alone sing of You, who are pleasing to Your Will.

blocks.scenario: You are faced with a choice that aligns with your desires but may not be pleasing to the Divine. Do you A) choose to align with His Will, or B) follow your own desires?

choices.text: Choose to align with His Will
Follow your own desires

blocks.why: The lesson emphasizes pleasing to His Will, aligning with choosing to align with the Divine's desires over personal ones.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, who sings of Him?
blocks.answer: They alone sing of You, who are pleasing to Your Will.

blocks.text: Strive to be pleasing to His Will and recognize the truth of His creation.
This lesson explores the importance of grace and humility. We will contemplate the True One's ability to embellish and exalt.
All Truth, all austere discipline, all goodness, are received only by Your Grace. What can the poor helpless creatures do? O Nanak, the True One embellishes and exalts.

blocks.scenario: You achieve a success. Do you A) acknowledge that it was received only by His Grace, or B) take full credit for your own abilities?

choices.text: Acknowledge that it was received only by His Grace
Take full credit for your own abilities

blocks.why: The lesson emphasizes that all goodness is received only by His Grace, aligning with acknowledging His role in success.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, how are Truth and goodness received?

blocks.text: Remember to acknowledge His Grace in all things and strive for humility.
This lesson focuses on the importance of remembering the True Name. The text says, "Chanting it, I live; forgetting it, I die." It also acknowledges that chanting the True Name can be difficult.

Remembering the Divine is essential for life, while forgetting leads to spiritual death.  It can be challenging to focus on the True Name.  However, a longing for the True Name is a sign of devotion, and the Master's Name is always True.

blocks.scenario: You are having a busy day and find it hard to focus on your spiritual practice.

choices.text: Take a few moments to remember the Divine, even briefly.
Continue with your tasks and postpone your practice for later.

blocks.why: Remembering the Divine, even for a short time, connects to the tags 'naam' and 'remembrance'.

blocks.question: According to the text, what happens when we forget the True Name?

blocks.text: Remembering the Divine, even amidst difficulty, is a path to spiritual life.

This lesson explores the themes of gratitude and the unending nature of Divine provision. The text states, "He continues to give, and His Provisions never run short." It also emphasizes that forgetting the Divine is undesirable.

The Divine is eternal and constantly provides for all.  This virtue belongs solely to the Divine, and there is no other like it. Forgetting the Divine is considered vile, while remembering brings us closer. The Divine's gifts are as great as the Divine itself.

blocks.scenario: You receive unexpected help from a friend when you are struggling with a task.

choices.text: Acknowledge the help with gratitude, recognizing the Divine's provision.
Accept the help without much thought, focusing only on completing the task.

blocks.why: Expressing gratitude for the help connects to the tags 'gratitude' and 'kirpa'.

blocks.question: According to the text, what happens to those who forget their Lord and Master?

blocks.text: Recognizing the Divine's constant provision and expressing gratitude can enrich our lives.

This lesson highlights the importance of the Divine Name and the company of the holy. The text mentions, "enlighten me with the Name of the Lord." It also states that joining the Sangat allows virtues to shine forth.

Seeking enlightenment through the Divine Name is essential.  The Guru's teachings make the Naam our breath of life.  Joining the Sangat, the holy congregation, allows our virtues to become apparent. Those without the Name are unfortunate.

blocks.scenario: You have the opportunity to attend a gathering of spiritually-minded people.

choices.text: Attend the gathering, hoping to learn and grow spiritually.
Decline the invitation, preferring to spend time alone.

blocks.why: Attending the gathering and seeking spiritual growth connects to the tags 'sangat' and 'kirpa'.

blocks.question: According to the text, what is the result of joining the Sangat?

blocks.text: Seeking the Divine Name and the company of the holy can lead to spiritual growth and fulfillment.

This lesson focuses on the benefits of the Sat Sangat and trusting in Divine provision. The text states, "Lord Himself provides for your care." It also mentions that joining the Sat Sangat leads to salvation.

The Divine provides for all, so there is no need to worry excessively.  Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, leads to being saved. Through the Guru's Grace, one can obtain the supreme status. The Light of the Naam shines forth in the Sat Sangat.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling anxious about your future and financial security.

choices.text: Reflect on the Divine's provision and trust that your needs will be met.
Continue to worry and plan excessively, trying to control every outcome.

blocks.why: Trusting in the Divine's provision connects to the tags 'kirpa' and 'contentment'.

blocks.question: According to the text, what is the result of joining the Sat Sangat?

blocks.text: Trusting in Divine provision and seeking the company of the holy can bring peace and contentment.
This lesson emphasizes the Divine's role as the provider and the importance of overcoming fear. The text asks, "Why are you so afraid, O mind?" It also highlights the limitlessness of the Divine.

The Divine provides sustenance for everyone, so there is no need to be afraid.  Even when it seems impossible, the Divine makes provisions. The Divine's expanse is without limit.  No one else is truly our support, only the Divine.

blocks.scenario: You are facing a challenging situation at work and feel overwhelmed by fear.

choices.text: Remember that the Divine provides sustenance and try to approach the situation with courage.
Give in to your fear and avoid dealing with the situation.

blocks.why: Remembering the Divine's provision and approaching the situation with courage connects to the tags 'fearlessness' and 'gratitude'.

blocks.question: According to the text, who provides sustenance for each and every person?

blocks.text: Trusting in the Divine's provision and overcoming fear can empower us to face challenges.

This lesson explores the themes of Divine purity, compassion, and the importance of meditation. The text states, "You are the Giver of all souls." It also mentions that meditating on the Fearless One dispels all fears.

The Divine is pure and the source of all life.  Meditating on the Divine dispels sorrow.  The Divine is both the Master and the Servant. Serving the Divine leads to being absorbed into the Divine Being.  Those who meditate on the Divine find peace and liberation.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling overwhelmed by sadness and anxiety.

choices.text: Take time to meditate on the Divine, seeking solace and peace.
Distract yourself with activities that provide temporary relief.

blocks.why: Meditating on the Divine connects to the tags 'naam' and 'compassion'.

blocks.question: According to the text, what happens to those who meditate on the Fearless One?

blocks.text: Meditating on the Divine and serving with compassion can bring peace, liberation, and a sense of oneness.

This lesson explores the themes of Divine greatness, will, and the importance of gratitude. The text states, "Everything happens according to Your Will." It also emphasizes that there is no other as Great as the Divine.

The Divine is the ultimate creator and there is no one as great. Everything happens according to the Divine's will. We receive what the Divine gives. The Divine is unchanging and eternal. Devotion to the Divine is an infinite treasure.

blocks.scenario: You experience an unexpected setback in your plans.

choices.text: Accept the setback as part of the Divine's will and try to learn from the experience.
Become frustrated and angry, blaming yourself or others for the setback.

blocks.why: Accepting the setback as part of the Divine's will connects to the tags 'hukam' and 'gratitude'.

blocks.question: According to the text, what happens according to the Divine's Will?

blocks.text: Accepting the Divine's will and expressing gratitude can bring peace and understanding.

This lesson focuses on the Divine's presence in all things and the importance of serving the Divine. The text states, "All belong to You, all meditate on you." It also mentions that those who serve the Divine find peace.

Everything belongs to the Divine, and all meditate on the Divine. The Divine is the River of Life, and all are within it. Those who are blessed with Divine Mercy obtain the Naam. Those who serve the Divine find peace and are absorbed into the Divine Name.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling disconnected from the Divine and searching for inner peace.

choices.text: Engage in selfless service, remembering that all belong to the Divine.
Focus solely on your own needs and desires, hoping to find happiness.

blocks.why: Engaging in selfless service and remembering the Divine connects to the tags 'naam' and 'kirpa'.

blocks.question: According to the text, what do those who serve the Divine find?

blocks.text: Serving the Divine and recognizing the Divine's presence in all things can lead to inner peace and a sense of belonging.
We read that the Creator is responsible for everything that happens. There is no one else besides the Creator. The Creator beholds and understands all of creation.

This passage emphasizes the oneness of the Creator and the idea that everything occurs by the Creator's will (Hukam). The Creator is not separate from creation but actively involved in it. Recognizing this can bring a sense of acceptance.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling frustrated because your plans changed unexpectedly. Do you:

choices.text: Accept that this change is part of the Creator's doing and adjust your plans accordingly.
Become angry and blame others for disrupting your plans.

blocks.why: Choosing A aligns with the tags 'oneness' and 'hukam' by recognizing the Creator's role in all events.

blocks.question: According to this passage, who is responsible for everything that happens?

blocks.text: Understanding that everything happens by the Creator's will can bring peace.
This passage encourages joining the Saadh Sangat (holy congregation) and meditating on the Naam (the Divine Name). It warns against wasting life in the love of Maya (illusion).
The passage suggests that worldly pursuits alone are not enough. Connecting with others in the Saadh Sangat and focusing on the Naam are important. This helps to avoid being caught up in Maya.

blocks.scenario: You have free time. Do you:

choices.text: Attend a gathering with spiritual people and reflect on the Divine.
Spend the time shopping for things you don't need.

blocks.why: Choosing A aligns with the tags 'sangat' and 'naam' by prioritizing spiritual connection over attachment to 'maya'.

blocks.question: What does the passage suggest we should join?

blocks.text: Connecting with others and focusing on the Divine can help us avoid being caught up in illusion.
This passage expresses humility and seeks sanctuary. It speaks of chanting praises to the Creator. It values the song of praise that brings peace.
The passage highlights the importance of recognizing our shortcomings and seeking refuge in the Divine. Praising the Creator is a path to peace. It suggests gratitude for what we have.

blocks.scenario: You feel inadequate after making a mistake. Do you:

choices.text: Acknowledge your mistake, seek guidance, and express gratitude for the opportunity to learn.
Become defensive and blame others for your mistake.

blocks.why: Choosing A aligns with 'humility', 'gratitude', and 'praise' by acknowledging shortcomings and seeking guidance.

blocks.question: What brings eternal peace, according to this passage?

blocks.text: Expressing humility and gratitude, and praising the Creator can bring peace to our lives.
This passage speaks of the Creator caring for all beings. It says the Creator's gifts are beyond measure. It encourages remembering the One who summons us.
The passage emphasizes the Creator's compassion and generosity. It reminds us to be mindful of the Divine presence in our lives. It suggests that everything is pre-ordained.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling worried about the future. Do you:

choices.text: Remember the Creator who cares for all beings and trust that things will unfold as they should.
Become overwhelmed with anxiety and try to control every detail of the future.

blocks.why: Choosing A aligns with 'compassion', 'remembrance', and 'hukam' by trusting in the Creator's care and pre-ordained plan.

blocks.question: What does the passage say the Great Giver does?

blocks.text: Remembering the Creator's compassion and trusting in the Divine plan can ease our worries.
This passage states that while there are many teachers and teachings, the Teacher of teachers is One. It says that many forms originate from the Creator. It values singing praises of the Creator.
The passage emphasizes the underlying unity of all things. Despite diversity, everything comes from the same source. Praising the Creator is a way to connect with this source.

blocks.scenario: You encounter someone with very different beliefs than your own. Do you:

choices.text: Recognize that both of you, despite your differences, originate from the same Creator.
Dismiss their beliefs as wrong and try to convince them to change their mind.

blocks.why: Choosing A aligns with 'oneness' and 'creation' by recognizing the shared origin of all beings.

blocks.question: According to this passage, where do many forms originate from?

blocks.text: Recognizing the underlying unity of all things can foster understanding and compassion.
This passage describes a cosmic worship service with the sun and moon as lamps. It praises the Destroyer of Fear. It states that the Creator has many forms, yet is formless.

The passage emphasizes the beauty and vastness of creation as a form of worship. It highlights the Creator's power to remove fear. It suggests that the Divine is both present in everything and beyond comprehension.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling anxious about a difficult situation. Do you:

choices.text: Reflect on the beauty and vastness of creation and remember the Destroyer of Fear.
Dwell on your worries and feel helpless.

blocks.why: Choosing A aligns with 'oneness', 'fearlessness', and 'praise' by connecting with the Divine and seeking strength.

blocks.question: What are the lamps in the cosmic worship service described in this passage?

blocks.text: Connecting with the beauty of creation and remembering the Divine can help us overcome fear.
This passage says that Light is radiant within all. It mentions the Guru's teachings. It asks for the Water of Mercy to dwell in the Divine Name.
The passage emphasizes the presence of the Divine Light within everyone. The Guru's teachings help us to see this Light. It suggests seeking Divine Mercy and dwelling in the Naam.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling disconnected from others. Do you:

choices.text: Remember that Light is radiant within all and seek to connect with others through compassion.
Isolate yourself and focus on your own problems.

blocks.why: Choosing A aligns with 'naam', 'kirpa', and 'compassion' by recognizing the Divine Light in all and seeking connection.

blocks.question: According to this passage, where is Light radiant?

blocks.text: Recognizing the Divine Light within everyone can foster connection and compassion.
This passage encourages greeting the Holy Saint and bowing down. It speaks of the thorn of egotism. It says that the fear of death is eradicated through the Name.
The passage emphasizes the importance of humility and service. Egotism causes suffering. Absorbing in the Divine Name removes the fear of death.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling proud of an accomplishment. Do you:

choices.text: Acknowledge your accomplishment with gratitude and continue to serve others with humility.
Brag about your accomplishment and seek praise from others.

blocks.why: Choosing A aligns with 'seva', 'haumai', and 'fearlessness' by practicing humility and avoiding egotism.

blocks.question: What is eradicated through the Name, according to this passage?

blocks.text: Practicing humility and service, and remembering the Divine can help us overcome egotism and fear.
This pauri expresses humility and the importance of serving others. It speaks of being meek and finding support in the Naam.

The verses convey a sense of belonging to God, seeking salvation, and finding peace through the Naam. Serving the saints is presented as an opportunity to gain profit in this world and peace hereafter. It also acknowledges the diminishing nature of life and the importance of resolving affairs with the Guru's guidance.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling overwhelmed by daily tasks and responsibilities. You could:

choices.text: Take a moment to reflect and offer help to someone in need.
Continue rushing through tasks without pausing.

blocks.why: Choosing to help someone aligns with the tags of humility and seva, reminding us to find peace through selfless service.

blocks.question: According to the text, where does one find celestial peace?
blocks.answer: In the Name of the Lord (Naam).

blocks.text: Remember to find strength in humility and service.
This pauri discusses the world's immersion in corruption and the importance of seeking truth. It emphasizes the significance of the Lord's grace and the company of saints.

The verses suggest that only those who recognize God are saved from the world's corruption. The 'Unspoken Speech of the Lord' is understood by those awakened by Him. The text encourages focusing on the purpose of life and finding the Lord within.

blocks.scenario: You encounter a situation where honesty is difficult. You could:

choices.text: Choose to speak the truth, even if it's uncomfortable.
Avoid the situation to prevent conflict.

blocks.why: Choosing truth aligns with the tags, reminding us to seek honesty and integrity in our actions.

blocks.question: According to the text, what saves one from corruption?

blocks.text: Strive to seek truth and inner peace.
This pauri explores the allure of worldly possessions and the importance of detachment. It emphasizes that without the Lord, the soul suffers.

The verses suggest that even the most luxurious possessions are meaningless without the presence of the Lord. The soul is scorched without the Lord. Consulting the Guru reveals that there is no other true refuge.

blocks.scenario: You are tempted to buy an expensive item you don't need. You could:

choices.text: Reflect on whether it truly brings you closer to inner peace.
Purchase the item to feel a temporary sense of satisfaction.

blocks.why: Choosing reflection aligns with the tags of maya and detachment, reminding us to prioritize inner peace over material possessions.

blocks.question: According to the text, what happens to the soul without the Lord?

blocks.text: Remember to seek contentment beyond material possessions.
This pauri reflects on the fleeting nature of worldly achievements and the importance of remembering God. It suggests that even great power and long life are meaningless without remembrance.

The verses illustrate that even if one could perform miracles, become an emperor, or live for millions of years, these accomplishments are insignificant if they lead to forgetting God. The Name is paramount.

blocks.scenario: You are praised for an accomplishment. You could:

choices.text: Acknowledge the praise but remember to stay grounded and grateful.
Let the praise inflate your ego and sense of self-importance.

blocks.why: Choosing gratitude aligns with the tags of maya and remembrance, reminding us to stay humble and focused on what truly matters.

blocks.question: According to the text, what might cause one to go astray?

blocks.text: Remember to stay grounded in remembrance, regardless of your achievements.
This pauri speaks of the Formless One and the importance of yearning for Him. It suggests that everything happens according to His will (Hukam).
The verses express a desire to be instilled with a yearning for the Lord. Even if one were to face extreme suffering or achieve great heights, it would not be enough to estimate His value.

blocks.scenario: You are facing a difficult situation. You could:

choices.text: Accept it as part of the divine will and seek strength through remembrance.
Become frustrated and resist the situation.

blocks.why: Choosing acceptance aligns with the tags of hukam and remembrance, reminding us to find peace in surrendering to the divine will.

blocks.question: According to the text, what should one seek to have instilled within?

blocks.text: Remember to find peace in accepting the divine will and yearning for the Lord.
This pauri discusses the deceptive nature of Maya and the importance of remembering the Name. It suggests that everything is pre-ordained.

The verses state that actions such as speaking, eating, walking, seeing, hearing, and breathing are all pre-ordained. The splendor of Maya is deceptive, and forgetting the Name leads to a state of limbo.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling envious of someone's possessions. You could:

choices.text: Recognize the deceptive nature of Maya and focus on the Name.
Dwell on your feelings of envy and desire those possessions.

blocks.why: Choosing to focus on the Name aligns with the tags, reminding us to avoid the trap of Maya and find contentment within.

blocks.question: According to the text, what is deceptive?

blocks.text: Remember to be mindful of the deceptive nature of Maya and focus on the Name.
This pauri emphasizes the greatness of God and the importance of humility. It speaks of God's grace towards the lowly.
The verses state that everyone acknowledges God as the Greatest. God is the master of all beings. His blessings rain down where the lowly are cared for.

blocks.scenario: You encounter someone who is less fortunate than you. You could:

choices.text: Offer help and support with humility.
Ignore their situation and focus on your own life.

blocks.why: Choosing to help aligns with the tags of humility and kirpa, reminding us to show compassion and support to those in need.

blocks.question: According to the text, who receives God's blessings?
