Pleasure and pain come by Your Will. Whatever You cause me to do, I do. All my days and nights are blessed when I chant the Lord's Name.
Both joy and sorrow are part of the divine will. Actions are guided by the divine. Chanting the Lord's name brings blessings to every moment.

blocks.scenario: You are experiencing both good and bad times.

choices.text: Remember that both experiences are part of the divine will, and focus on chanting the Lord's name.
Only focus on the good times and try to avoid the bad times.

blocks.why: This lesson emphasizes accepting divine will and finding blessings through chanting.

blocks.question: What brings blessings to all days and nights?

blocks.text: Accept the divine will and find blessings in every moment.
He does the deeds pre-ordained and inscribed upon his forehead. The One is prevailing everywhere, in every heart. Lift me out of the deep pit; I have taken to Your Sanctuary.
Actions are determined by destiny. The divine is present in all beings. Seeking refuge in the divine can lift one from worldly suffering.

blocks.scenario: You feel trapped by circumstances.

choices.text: Remember that the divine is everywhere and seek refuge in the divine.
Try to escape the circumstances by any means necessary.

blocks.why: This lesson emphasizes the presence of the divine and seeking refuge in it.

blocks.question: Where is the One prevailing?

blocks.text: Find solace and guidance by seeking refuge in the divine.
He who created the world is the One Lord. Blessed is the birth of those committed to His Service. O mind, why forget Him? The Primal Lord is the Giver; He alone is True.
The creator is the sole master. Serving the divine brings blessings. Forgetting the divine is foolish. The divine is the true giver.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling distracted and forgetful.

choices.text: Remember the divine and commit to serving the divine.
Try to improve your memory through exercises.

blocks.why: This lesson emphasizes remembering the divine and committing to service.

blocks.question: Who is the true giver?

blocks.text: Remember the divine and commit to service.
Sing the Praises of the One whose limit cannot be found. Those who perform service and practice truth obtain rewards. One who understands spiritual wisdom becomes a scholar.
The divine is limitless and worthy of praise. Service and truthfulness lead to rewards. Understanding spiritual wisdom brings knowledge.

blocks.scenario: You are seeking guidance on how to live a meaningful life.

choices.text: Perform service, practice truth, and seek spiritual wisdom.
Focus on accumulating wealth and power.

blocks.why: This lesson emphasizes service, truth, and spiritual wisdom as paths to a meaningful life.

blocks.question: What do service and truthfulness lead to?

blocks.text: Live a meaningful life through service, truth, and spiritual wisdom.
The Creator is the King, and all the world is bound by His command. No other command prevails. One who recognizes bad and good as one and the same is absorbed into the Lord.
The Creator nourishes and binds the world. Everything happens according to His will. Recognizing the unity of good and bad leads to absorption in the Divine.

blocks.scenario: You are deciding whether to accept a new job that pays more but requires longer hours. A) You accept the job, trusting that the Creator provides. B) You decline the job, content with your current situation.

choices.text: Accept the job, trusting the Creator.
Decline the job, remaining content.

blocks.why: This choice aligns with the idea that the Creator is the King and provides nourishment, and that all things happen by His command.

blocks.question: According to this passage, who binds the world?

blocks.text: Recognizing the Creator's command in all things can bring peace.
Doubt exists within everyone, created by the Lord. Those blessed with His Mercy meet with the Guru. The One Lord gives and takes; there is no other.
Doubt is part of the human experience, but divine grace leads to the Guru. Ultimately, everything comes from and returns to the One Lord. Seeking wisdom is a long journey.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling uncertain about a major life decision. A) You seek guidance from a trusted mentor. B) You try to figure it out on your own, relying solely on your own understanding.

choices.text: Seek guidance from a trusted mentor.
Rely solely on your own understanding.

blocks.why: Seeking guidance aligns with the idea that meeting the Guru (or a mentor) is a blessing of mercy that helps overcome doubt.

blocks.question: According to this passage, what leads to meeting the Guru?

blocks.text: Seeking guidance can help overcome doubt.
Why worry? The Lord gives and watches over us, providing nourishment according to His orders. When the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, only the One Lord is seen, pervading everywhere.
There is no need to be anxious, as the Lord provides for all. Recognizing the One Lord's presence everywhere comes through His grace. Avoid hypocrisy and focus on the Lord's sanctuary.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling stressed about finances. A) You trust that your needs will be met. B) You become consumed with worry and anxiety.

choices.text: Trust that your needs will be met.
Become consumed with worry and anxiety.

blocks.why: Trusting that your needs will be met aligns with the idea that the Lord gives and watches over us, providing nourishment.

blocks.question: According to this passage, what pervades everywhere?

blocks.text: Trusting in the Lord's provision can reduce anxiety.
Peace comes from linking consciousness to the Lord's Lotus Feet. Serve the One who is contained in everyone to obtain peace. He acts as He pleases.
Connecting with the Divine brings inner peace. Serving others, recognizing the Divine in all, leads to peace. The Lord's will is supreme, and He watches over His creation.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling restless and disconnected. A) You volunteer your time to help others in your community. B) You focus on your own needs and desires.

choices.text: Volunteer your time to help others.
Focus on your own needs and desires.

blocks.why: Volunteering aligns with the idea of serving the One who is contained and pervading among everyone, which leads to peace.

blocks.question: According to this passage, how can one obtain peace?
blocks.answer: By serving Him who is contained and pervading among everyone.

blocks.text: Serving others can bring inner peace.
Singing the Lord's praises prevents reincarnation. The world-ocean is deep, and we need saving. Everything is by His doing; what pleases Him is good.
Devotion can break the cycle of rebirth. The world is challenging, and we need divine help. Doubt and Maya are part of His creation; accepting His will is beneficial.

blocks.scenario: You are facing a difficult situation and feel overwhelmed. A) You accept the situation as part of the Lord's will. B) You resist the situation and become angry.

choices.text: Accept the situation as part of the Lord's will.
Resist the situation and become angry.

blocks.why: Accepting the situation aligns with the idea that everything is by His doing and what pleases Him is good.

blocks.question: According to this passage, what prevents reincarnation?

blocks.text: Accepting the Lord's will can bring peace in difficult times.
Blame your own actions, not others. His power upholds the earth, and His gifts are received by all. All act according to His command.
We experience the consequences of our own deeds. The Lord's power sustains everything, and His gifts are available to everyone. Everything happens according to His will.

blocks.scenario: You experience a setback in your personal life. A) You reflect on your own actions and take responsibility. B) You blame others for your misfortune.

choices.text: Reflect on your own actions and take responsibility.
Blame others for your misfortune.

blocks.why: Reflecting on your own actions aligns with the idea of blaming your own actions, not others.

blocks.question: According to this passage, whose actions should we blame?

blocks.text: Taking responsibility for our actions can lead to growth.
The Supreme King watches over the world, knowing everything. The world is caught in the noose of death, but by Guru's Grace, some are saved. He made all beings and creatures.
The Divine oversees all creation. Death is a reality, but the Guru's grace offers liberation. All beings are part of the Divine's play.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling anxious about the future. A) You seek guidance and support from a spiritual mentor. B) You try to control every aspect of your life to avoid uncertainty.

choices.text: Seek guidance and support from a spiritual mentor.
Try to control every aspect of your life to avoid uncertainty.

blocks.why: Seeking guidance aligns with the idea that by Guru's Grace, some are saved.

blocks.question: According to this passage, what can save us from the noose of death?

blocks.text: Seeking guidance can ease anxieties about the future.
Those who search find rewards and live in the Fear of God. The Gurmukh speaks, understands, and knows only the One Lord. Recognizing the True Lord prevents reincarnation.
Seeking the Divine leads to blessings and reverence. The Gurmukh embodies divine wisdom and oneness. True understanding prevents rebirth.

blocks.scenario: You are trying to learn a new skill. A) You approach the learning process with reverence and dedication. B) You approach the learning process casually and without much effort.

choices.text: Approach the learning process with reverence and dedication.
Approach the learning process casually and without much effort.

blocks.why: Approaching the learning process with reverence and dedication aligns with the idea that those who search find rewards.

blocks.question: According to this passage, what does the Gurmukh know?

blocks.text: Approaching life with reverence can lead to rewards.
The Lord is contained in all beings, created by Him. Those who remember the Naam receive His Grace. We should accept what comes by His Command.
The Lord is present everywhere and in everyone. He gives grace to those who remember Him. We should accept both good and bad with His will.

blocks.scenario: You are having a difficult day at work, but you remember that everything happens by His Command. Do you:

choices.text: Accept the situation and try to do your best.
Complain and blame others for your problems.

blocks.why: Accepting the situation aligns with the idea of enduring equally whatever occurs by His Command, connecting to the 'hukam' tag.

blocks.question: According to this passage, who receives His Grace?

blocks.text: Remembering the Lord's presence can help us accept life's challenges.
Meditate on the Imperishable Lord and be absorbed into the True One. He is the Giver who nourishes all. Meditate on His Name, day and night.
We should focus on the unchanging Lord and merge with Truth. He provides for all beings. Constant meditation on His Name brings profit.

blocks.scenario: You want to feel more connected to the Divine. Do you:

choices.text: Spend time each day meditating on the Lord's Name.
Focus only on your daily tasks and ignore spiritual practices.

blocks.why: Meditating on the Lord's name aligns with the passage's emphasis on 'naam' and 'devotion', fostering a connection to truth.

blocks.question: Who is the Giver of nourishment?

blocks.text: Consistent devotion to the Lord's Name can bring us closer to truth.
The world will pass away. People commit sins and forget virtue. Remember the Lord, or you will have to answer for your actions.
Everything created is temporary. Engaging in negative actions leads to forgetting what is right. Remembering the Lord is important because we are accountable for our deeds.

blocks.scenario: You are tempted to gossip about a friend. Do you:

choices.text: Resist the temptation and focus on positive thoughts.
Give in and participate in the gossip.

blocks.why: Resisting temptation aligns with remembering virtue and avoiding sin, connecting to the 'maya' tag as a distraction from the divine.

blocks.question: What do people forget when they fall into vice?

blocks.text: Remembering virtue helps us avoid negative actions.
Do not waste your life in doubt. Without the Shabad, you will be reborn again. Read what is written on your forehead.
Living in confusion is unproductive. Remembering the One Word is important to avoid repeated rebirths. We should understand our destiny.

blocks.scenario: You feel lost and confused about your purpose. Do you:

choices.text: Reflect on your life and seek guidance from the Shabad.
Continue living without direction, ignoring your inner voice.

blocks.why: Seeking guidance from the Shabad aligns with the passage's emphasis on remembering the One Word and avoiding repeated rebirths, connecting to the 'shabad' tag.

blocks.question: What happens if you do not remember the One Word of the Shabad?
blocks.answer: You will have to enter the womb over and over again.

blocks.text: Understanding the Shabad can help us find direction in life.
You have lost self-discipline and are afflicted with ego. You compromise yourself for Maya. Attached to possessiveness, you have forgotten the Lord.
Lack of self-control and ego cause us to make poor choices. We become attached to worldly things and forget the Divine. Understanding without action is not enough.

blocks.scenario: You are tempted to buy something you don't need to impress others. Do you:

choices.text: Resist the temptation and focus on your true needs.
Give in and buy the item to feel better about yourself.

blocks.why: Resisting the temptation aligns with avoiding attachment to possessions and controlling desires, connecting to the 'maya' and 'ego' tags.

blocks.question: What is the great disease?

blocks.text: Controlling desires and ego helps us remember the Lord.
You are engrossed in worldly affairs. This is your destiny. By Guru's Grace, one who knows the Lord is carried across.
Being too involved in the world can prevent spiritual progress. Our lives are shaped by destiny. Knowing the Lord through the Guru's Grace can lead to liberation.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling overwhelmed by your responsibilities. Do you:

choices.text: Seek guidance and support, trusting in the Guru's Grace.
Try to handle everything on your own, feeling stressed and alone.

blocks.why: Seeking guidance aligns with the passage's emphasis on Guru's Grace and trusting in the Divine will, connecting to the 'grace' and 'destiny' tags.

blocks.question: How can one be carried across the world-ocean?

blocks.text: Trusting in Guru's Grace can help us navigate life's challenges.
Listen to the Teachings of the True Guru. Without a Guru, there is no Guru. Restrain your wandering mind; the treasure is within you.
Following the Guru's guidance is essential. Without a true guide, there is no guidance. Controlling the mind allows us to find inner peace.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling anxious and your mind is racing. Do you:

choices.text: Practice mindfulness and try to calm your thoughts.
Let your thoughts control you, feeling overwhelmed and stressed.

blocks.why: Practicing mindfulness aligns with restraining the wandering mind and seeking inner peace, connecting to the 'mind' and 'gurmukh' tags.

blocks.question: Where is the treasure to be found?

blocks.text: Controlling the mind helps us find inner peace and guidance.
Keep the Lord in your mind. Enshrine the Guru's feet in your heart. Abide with those whose hearts are filled with the Lord to attain eternal peace.
Remembering the Lord and following the Guru's teachings are important. Being in the company of devoted people helps us find peace. Understanding comes through grace.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling disconnected and lonely. Do you:

choices.text: Seek out the company of people who are devoted to the Lord.
Isolate yourself and avoid social interaction.

blocks.why: Seeking the company of devoted people aligns with abiding with those whose hearts are filled with the Lord, connecting to the 'sangat' tag and fostering peace.

blocks.question: How can you have your past sins forgiven?
blocks.answer: Enshrine the Guru's feet within your heart.

blocks.text: Being in good company helps us remember the Lord and find peace.
This lesson explores the love and devotion for the Lord. It speaks of the indescribable nature of the Lord and the joy of union with Him.

The Lord's limits are unknowable, and He is beyond description. Meeting the True Guru settles one's accounts, leading to a joyful union. The soul-bride delights in gazing upon her Husband Lord, filled with joy and intoxicated with His company, finding peace through His Name.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling overwhelmed by the world. You remember the importance of connecting with something greater than yourself.

choices.text: Take a moment to reflect on the virtues you admire and offer a prayer of gratitude.
Continue with your busy schedule, hoping the feeling will pass.

blocks.why: Reflecting on virtues and offering gratitude aligns with the lesson's emphasis on love, devotion, and finding peace through connection with the Lord, as represented by the tag 'love'.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, what happens when the soul-bride gazes upon her Husband Lord?
blocks.answer: She is delighted, and her mind is filled with joy.

blocks.text: Find joy and peace by connecting with the Divine through love and devotion.
This lesson focuses on the importance of the Lord's Name and Grace. It describes the soul's journey to merge with the Divine through love and devotion.

The Lord's Name is invaluable, and those who purchase it experience unlimited sweetness. Meeting the Lord is a blessing, arranged by His Grace. The soul-bride, imbued with His love, captivates His heart, finding joy and peace through the Shabad.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling unworthy and disconnected. You remember the importance of seeking the Lord's grace.

choices.text: Reflect on the Lord's Name and ask for His grace to guide you.
Continue to feel unworthy and disconnected.

blocks.why: Reflecting on the Lord's Name and seeking His grace aligns with the lesson's emphasis on 'naam' and 'grace' as paths to connection and worthiness.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, how does one obtain the Lord?
blocks.answer: Only by love does the mind obtain Him.

blocks.text: Seek the Lord's grace and find peace through love and devotion to His Name.
This lesson explores the path to reaching the Divine through truth and the Guru's teachings. It emphasizes the importance of inner purity and subduing the ego.

The unreachable city is reached by practicing truthfulness, self-restraint, and contemplating the Guru's Shabad. This leads to inner peace and virtue. By renouncing vices and subduing ego, greed, and avarice, one finds the Lord.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling overwhelmed by negative emotions like anger and greed. You remember the importance of inner purity.

choices.text: Take a moment to reflect on these emotions and try to release them, focusing on truthfulness and self-restraint.
Continue to be consumed by the negative emotions.

blocks.why: Reflecting on and releasing negative emotions aligns with the lesson's emphasis on renouncing vices and subduing ego, as represented by the tag 'ego'.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, what is essential for reaching the Divine?
blocks.answer: Practicing truthfulness and self-restraint, contemplating His Glorious Virtues, and living the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

blocks.text: Strive for inner purity and subdue your ego to find the path to the Divine.
This lesson highlights the importance of the Lord's Name and detachment from worldly attachments. It emphasizes the role of a Gurmukh in realizing the Divine.

The Lord's Name is our only true friend, as worldly attachments are fleeting. A Gurmukh realizes the Shabad and meditates on the Naam, detaching from Maya and focusing on the Divine. By contemplating the True Lord, one's mind becomes pure.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling overly attached to material possessions. You remember the importance of detachment.

choices.text: Reflect on the impermanence of material possessions and try to release your attachment to them.
Continue to be consumed by your attachment to material possessions.

blocks.why: Reflecting on the impermanence of possessions and releasing attachment aligns with the lesson's emphasis on 'detachment' from Maya.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, what is our only true friend?

blocks.text: Find true friendship and purity by detaching from worldly attachments and focusing on the Lord's Name.
This lesson explores how God's Grace leads to peace. It speaks of conquering ego through service and remaining pleased with the Lord's will.

By God's Grace, peace is obtained in the company of the holy. Renunciates absorbed in devotion are rid of desires. Rare is the unattached servant who conquers his ego and remains pleased with the Lord. Meditating on Him brings an end to birth and death.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling frustrated because things are not going your way. You remember the importance of accepting the Lord's will.

choices.text: Take a moment to reflect and accept that things are happening according to the Lord's will.
Continue to be frustrated and resist the situation.

blocks.why: Accepting the Lord's will aligns with the lesson's emphasis on remaining pleased with the Lord, as represented by the tag 'grace'.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, how is peace obtained?
blocks.answer: By God's Grace, in the Company of the Holy.

blocks.text: Conquer your ego and find peace by accepting the Lord's will and seeking His Grace.
This lesson focuses on serving the Lord and meditating on His Name. It speaks of accepting His Hukam (Will) and the benefits of Naam Simran.

Serve the Lord and gather profit, obtaining honor in His Court. Meditating on the Lord through the Guru's teachings brings treasures. Those who chant the Naam are beautiful and obtain peace. Without the Lord, there is no protector.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling lost and unsure of your purpose. You remember the importance of serving the Lord.

choices.text: Reflect on how you can serve others and dedicate your actions to the Lord.
Continue to feel lost and unsure of your purpose.

blocks.why: Reflecting on how to serve others aligns with the lesson's emphasis on 'seva' and dedicating actions to the Lord.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, what happens to those who chant the Naam?
blocks.answer: They look beautiful and obtain the fruit of peace.

blocks.text: Serve the Lord, meditate on His Name, and accept His Hukam to find purpose and peace.
This lesson explores the dangers of attachment to Maya and the importance of the Shabad. It speaks of detachment and uniting with the Divine.

Attachment to worldly pleasures leads to pain. Without the Shabad, one is bound and beaten on the road of death. The love of Maya is sweet but ultimately delusive. Through the Shabad, those separated from the Lord are united once again.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling tempted by a fleeting pleasure, even though you know it will lead to negative consequences. You remember the importance of detachment from Maya.

choices.text: Reflect on the long-term consequences of the pleasure and choose to detach from it.
Give in to the temptation, knowing it will lead to negative consequences.

blocks.why: Reflecting on the consequences and choosing detachment aligns with the lesson's emphasis on 'detachment' from Maya.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, what happens without the Word of the Shabad?
blocks.answer: You shall be bound and beaten on the road of Death.

blocks.text: Detach from Maya, focus on the Shabad, and unite with the Divine.
This lesson explores the importance of the Shabad and devotion in attaining union with the Divine. It speaks of eradicating ego and the consequences of duality.

The soul-bride meets her Husband Lord through God's grace, adorning herself with the True Word of the Shabad and eradicating her ego. Without the Name, the soul-bride wanders around, deluded by doubt. Through the True Word of the Shabad, one meets the Lord.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling disconnected from others and the Divine. You remember the importance of the Shabad and devotion.

choices.text: Reflect on the Shabad and offer a prayer of devotion to connect with the Divine.
Continue to feel disconnected.

blocks.why: Reflecting on the Shabad and offering a prayer of devotion aligns with the lesson's emphasis on 'shabad' and 'devotion' as paths to union with the Divine.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, how does the soul-bride meet her Husband Lord?
blocks.answer: Through God's grace, adorning herself with the True Word of the Shabad and eradicating her ego.

blocks.text: Connect with the Divine through the Shabad, devotion, and eradicating your ego.

This lesson explores the bliss of connecting with the Divine through the Guru's guidance and grace. It emphasizes the importance of dedicating oneself to devotional worship and realizing the Lord's command.

The verses describe the joy of the soul-bride meeting her Beloved Lord through the Guru's Shabad. It highlights that dedicating oneself to the Lord's worship, guided by the Guru's grace, leads to bliss and resolution of affairs. Realizing the Lord's command brings peace and comfort.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling lost and unsure of your path. Do you:

choices.text: Seek guidance from a trusted mentor or spiritual teacher and dedicate yourself to their teachings.
Rely solely on your own understanding and cleverness to navigate the situation.

blocks.why: This aligns with the tags 'naam', 'guru', and 'grace' by emphasizing the importance of seeking guidance and dedicating oneself to devotional worship.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, what brings peace and comfort?

blocks.text: By seeking guidance and dedicating ourselves to devotional worship, we can find bliss and resolve our affairs.
This lesson focuses on the nature of the mind and the importance of reflecting upon the Guru's Shabad. It emphasizes recognizing the Divine Light within and understanding our origin.

The verses convey that the Lord is always with us, no matter where our mind wanders. By reflecting on the Guru's Shabad, the wandering mind can be held steady and abide in its own home. Recognizing our origin as the embodiment of Divine Light allows us to experience the Lord's love and understand life and death.

blocks.scenario: You find your mind constantly racing with thoughts and worries. Do you:

choices.text: Take time to reflect on spiritual teachings and try to still your mind through meditation or prayer.
Get caught up in your thoughts and allow your mind to wander without any focus.

blocks.why: This choice aligns with the tags 'mind', 'shabad', and 'oneness' by emphasizing the importance of reflecting on teachings to steady the mind.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, what happens when the mind is held steady?
blocks.answer: It comes to abide in its own home.

blocks.text: By reflecting on spiritual teachings and recognizing the Divine Light within, we can steady our minds and experience the Lord's love.

This lesson addresses the dangers of pride and ego and emphasizes the importance of humility. It highlights the path of the Gurmukh, who renounces ego and finds peace in surrendering to the Divine will.

The verses warn against being full of pride, as it leads to regret and wasted life. The Gurmukh, on the other hand, is humble and modest, washing away ignorance and ego through the Shabad. Renouncing ego and surrendering to the Guru's will brings peace and allows the Lord to come into our consciousness.

blocks.scenario: You receive praise for an accomplishment. Do you:

choices.text: Acknowledge the praise with humility, recognizing that your abilities are a gift.
Become boastful and take all the credit for yourself.

blocks.why: This aligns with the tags 'ego', 'humility', and 'gurmukh' by emphasizing the importance of humility and avoiding pride.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, what happens when we renounce ego and self-conceit?

blocks.text: By renouncing ego and embracing humility, we can find peace and allow the Divine to come into our consciousness.
This lesson explores the concept of Hukam (Divine Will) and the challenges of doubt. It emphasizes the importance of understanding and aligning with the Lord's command through devotion and the Naam.

The verses describe how some are misled into doubt by the Lord Himself, wandering in duality. Realizing the Lord's command is rare, but essential. The Lord's greatness is true, and when enshrined in the mind, one sings His praises. By enshrining the Naam within, doubts and sorrows depart.

blocks.scenario: You are facing a difficult decision and feel uncertain about the right path. Do you:

choices.text: Reflect on your values and seek guidance through prayer or meditation, trusting in a higher power to guide you.
Become paralyzed by doubt and avoid making a decision altogether.

blocks.why: This aligns with the tags 'hukam', 'doubt', and 'naam' by emphasizing the importance of seeking guidance and trusting in a higher power.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, what departs when the Name of the Lord is enshrined within?

blocks.text: By understanding and aligning with the Divine Will and enshrining the Naam within, we can overcome doubt and find true greatness.
This lesson contrasts the path of the self-willed manmukh with the path of the Guru. It emphasizes the importance of seeking the sanctuary of the Guru and purchasing the Naam.

The verses describe how self-willed manmukhs cling to Maya and die in their stubbornness. By seeking the sanctuary of the Guru, one can cross over the world-ocean. The Guru is the Divine Banker from whom we seek the wealth of the Lord, to purchase the Naam and find absorption into the Absolute Lord.

blocks.scenario: You are faced with a choice between pursuing material wealth and seeking spiritual growth. Do you:

choices.text: Dedicate yourself to seeking spiritual growth and the Naam, understanding that true wealth lies within.
Focus solely on accumulating material wealth, believing that it will bring you happiness.

blocks.why: This aligns with the tags 'manmukh', 'guru', and 'naam' by emphasizing the importance of seeking spiritual growth and the Naam over material wealth.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, what can one purchase from the Guru?

blocks.text: By seeking the sanctuary of the Guru and purchasing the Naam, we can find true wealth and absorption into the Absolute Lord.
This lesson emphasizes the importance of the Naam, the path of the Gurmukh, and the value of seva (selfless service). It highlights how these elements lead to liberation and union with the Divine.

The verses describe how the Gurmukh beholds the Lord and finds the Name to be his glory. The Lord's Name is the boat that carries the Gurmukh across the world-ocean. By chanting the Name and associating with the Guru, one finds liberation and has their affairs perfected. The Lord is revealed through the Guru's teachings.

blocks.scenario: You see someone struggling to carry groceries. Do you:

choices.text: Offer to help them carry their groceries, performing a selfless act of service.
Ignore them and continue on your way.

blocks.why: This aligns with the tags 'naam', 'gurmukh', and 'seva' by emphasizing the importance of selfless service.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, what carries the Gurmukh across the world-ocean?

blocks.text: By embracing the Naam, following the path of the Gurmukh, and performing selfless service, we can find liberation and union with the Divine.

This lesson contrasts the path of the self-willed manmukh with the path of those who remember the Lord's Name. It emphasizes the importance of controlling the mind and forsaking anxiety through devotion.

The verses describe how foolish manmukhs forget the Lord's Name and are engrossed in Maya. The path of death is arduous for them. The Gurmukh, however, meditates on the Naam and finds salvation. Those whose minds are filled with the Lord's Name forsake all anxiety and obtain all wealth and Dharmic faith.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling overwhelmed with anxiety about the future. Do you:

choices.text: Turn to prayer or meditation, focusing on the Lord's Name to calm your mind and release your anxieties.
Allow your anxieties to consume you, dwelling on your fears and worries.

blocks.why: This aligns with the tags 'manmukh', 'naam', and 'mind' by emphasizing the importance of focusing on the Lord's Name to calm the mind and release anxieties.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, what do those whose minds are filled with the Lord's Name forsake?

blocks.text: By filling our minds with the Lord's Name, we can forsake anxiety and find peace and fulfillment.
This lesson emphasizes the importance of faith in the Lord's Name, service to the Lord, and dedication to the Guru. It highlights how these elements lead to union with the Divine and liberation.

The verses describe how those who place their faith in the Lord's Name do not attach their consciousness to another. The Lord's Name is their support and wealth. The Lord's servant commits himself to the Guru's service, offering his mind and body. The Guru's Sikh and the Sikh's Guru are one and the same. Service to the Lord is more exalted than anything.

blocks.scenario: You are presented with an opportunity to serve others in your community. Do you:

choices.text: Embrace the opportunity to serve, dedicating your time and energy to helping those in need.
Decline the opportunity, prioritizing your own personal interests and comfort.

blocks.why: Choosing to reflect and remember God aligns with the lesson's emphasis on devotion and seeking sanctuary, contrasting with the fleeting nature of Maya.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, what brings bliss and fulfills desires?

blocks.text: True protection and fulfillment come from devotion and remembering God, not from worldly attachments.

This lesson focuses on the transformative power of the Saadh Sangat (holy congregation) and the importance of chanting God's Name. We will explore how these practices can bring peace and protect us from negative influences.

The verses describe how the Creator enters one's home, burning away inner demons through the Saadh Sangat. By Guru's grace, one can find peace and union with God, renouncing attachments and egotism. Remembering the Lord fulfills all hopes and brings victory in life.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling anxious and overwhelmed by negative thoughts. You have the option to either spend the evening alone, dwelling on these thoughts, or to join a local gathering for prayer and reflection. Which action aligns better with the lesson?

choices.text: Join the gathering for prayer and reflection, seeking the company of the holy.
Spend the evening alone, dwelling on negative thoughts.

blocks.why: Joining the gathering aligns with the lesson's emphasis on the Saadh Sangat and chanting God's Name, which brings peace and protection.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, what is obtained by vibrating upon the Lord in the Saadh Sangat?
blocks.answer: Dharmic faith, patience, peace and poise.

blocks.text: Finding peace and protection is possible through the Saadh Sangat and remembering God's Name.

This lesson explores the concept of karma and the importance of performing good deeds and chanting God's Name. We will reflect on how our actions are recorded and how the Saadh Sangat can help erase sins.

The verses remind us that our actions are always recorded and seen by the Creator. Performing good deeds and chanting the Naam prevents us from going to hell. Joining the Saadh Sangat helps erase sins, and remembering the Lord saves all relations.

blocks.scenario: You are faced with a decision: either gossip about a colleague to gain favor with others, or refrain from gossip and focus on your own work. Which action aligns better with the lesson?

choices.text: Refrain from gossip and focus on your own work, performing good deeds.
Gossip about a colleague to gain favor with others.

blocks.why: Refraining from gossip aligns with the lesson's emphasis on performing good deeds and avoiding actions that lead to negative consequences.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, what helps erase sins?
blocks.answer: Vibrating continually in the Saadh Sangat.

blocks.text: Performing good deeds, chanting God's Name, and joining the Saadh Sangat are ways to improve our karma and find peace.
This lesson explores the impermanence of the world and the importance of remembering God. We will reflect on how to burn away the love of duality and merge in peace.

The verses remind us that the world is a mirage and worldly pleasures are temporary. Remembering God day and night is essential. Without the One Lord, there is nothing else, and we must burn away the love of duality to find peace.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling anxious about an upcoming event and find yourself constantly worrying about what might go wrong. You can either dwell on these worries or try to focus on remembering God. Which action aligns better with the lesson?

choices.text: Focus on remembering God, knowing that He is your friend and everything.
Dwell on the worries and anxieties about the upcoming event.

blocks.why: Focusing on remembering God aligns with the lesson's emphasis on finding peace by burning away duality and remembering the One Lord.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, what should we burn away to find peace?

blocks.text: Finding peace involves recognizing the impermanence of the world and remembering God.
This lesson explores the themes of love, grace, and devotion to the Lord. We will reflect on the intense love for the Divine and how grace can erase sins.

The verses describe the intense love and longing for the Divine, comparing it to the bumblebee's love for the lotus. By focusing consciousness on the Lord and receiving His grace, sins are erased. Meditating on the Lord brings an end to suffering.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling disconnected from your spiritual practice and long for a deeper connection with the Divine. You can either continue with your routine or dedicate time to prayer and meditation. Which action aligns better with the lesson?

choices.text: Dedicate time to prayer and meditation, focusing your consciousness on the Lord.
Continue with your routine, hoping the feeling of disconnection will pass.

blocks.why: Dedicating time to prayer and meditation aligns with the lesson's emphasis on focusing consciousness on the Lord and seeking a deeper connection.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, what is erased by the Lord's Glance of Grace?

blocks.text: Cultivating love and devotion for the Divine and seeking His grace can bring an end to suffering.
This lesson explores the importance of the Guru and the nature of creation. We will reflect on how the Lord created Himself and the creation, and how He bestows His Mercy.

The verses emphasize that those who do not remember the Guru are lost. The Lord created Himself and the creation, and He bestows His Mercy according to His Pleasure. He is the Knower of all and beholds the creation with delight.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling lost and unsure of which path to take in life. You can either rely solely on your own understanding or seek guidance from a spiritual mentor. Which action aligns better with the lesson?

choices.text: Seek guidance from a spiritual mentor, remembering the importance of the Guru.
Rely solely on your own understanding, thinking of yourself as clever.

blocks.why: Seeking guidance from a spiritual mentor aligns with the lesson's emphasis on the importance of the Guru and avoiding the trap of thinking oneself as clever.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, who created Himself and the creation?

blocks.text: Remembering the Guru and acknowledging the Lord's creation are essential for finding direction in life.
This lesson explores the concept of Truth and the Lord's Command. We will reflect on the True nature of the worlds, the creation, and the importance of meditating on the True One.

The verses emphasize the True nature of the Lord's worlds, creation, and Command. Everything is True in the Lord, and those who meditate on the True One are also true. The Lord's greatness is beyond description, and everything happens by His Will.

blocks.scenario: You are faced with a situation where you can either be honest and truthful, even if it's difficult, or take a shortcut and be dishonest. Which action aligns better with the lesson?

choices.text: Be honest and truthful, even if it's difficult.
Take a shortcut and be dishonest.

blocks.why: Being honest and truthful aligns with the lesson's emphasis on the True nature of the Lord and the importance of meditating on the True One.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, what are those who meditate on the True One?

blocks.text: Embracing Truth in our actions and meditating on the True One are essential for spiritual growth.
This lesson explores the themes of karma, destiny, and the wonders of creation. We will reflect on how our actions are judged and the all-encompassing power of the Lord.

The verses describe how the Righteous Judge of Dharma records our accounts, and only the Truth is judged true. Those imbued with the Lord's Name win, while cheaters lose. The lesson also marvels at the wonders of creation and emphasizes that everything is in the Lord's Power.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling envious of someone else's success. You can either dwell on your envy or focus on appreciating the wonders of creation and the Lord's power. Which action aligns better with the lesson?

choices.text: Focus on appreciating the wonders of creation and the Lord's power.
Dwell on your envy and resentment.

blocks.why: Focusing on appreciating the wonders of creation aligns with the lesson's emphasis on recognizing the Lord's power and avoiding negative emotions.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, who wins in the Lord's court?
blocks.answer: Those who are imbued with Your Name.

blocks.text: Recognizing the Lord's power and appreciating the wonders of creation can help us overcome negative emotions and find peace.
This lesson discusses the cycle of life and death, the role of God's Fear, and the ultimate fate of our physical bodies. We will explore how everything operates within God's command.

The verses describe how worldly pleasures eventually lead to ashes and the soul's departure. Everything, from the wind to the moon, operates within the Fear of God. Even powerful figures are subject to death and judgment, highlighting the importance of deeds.

blocks.scenario: You see a friend obsessing over material possessions, neglecting their well-being and relationships. Which action reflects the lesson?

choices.text: Gently remind them about the impermanence of material things and the importance of inner peace.
Join them in their pursuit of wealth, hoping to share in their success.

blocks.why: This choice aligns with the lesson's emphasis on the temporary nature of worldly pleasures and the importance of spiritual awareness. The tags are death and fear.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, what happens to those who indulge only in worldly pleasures?
blocks.answer: They are reduced to ashes after death.

blocks.text: Reflecting on the impermanence of life can help us prioritize what truly matters.
This lesson focuses on the significance of the True Guru and the divine knowledge. It contrasts worldly entanglements with the path to realizing the True Name.

The verses state that the True Guru is found through the Lord's mercy and instructs us in the Shabad. Without divine knowledge, one is lost in Maya. Those with the Fear of God also have love for God in their minds.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling lost and disconnected. Which action reflects the lesson?

choices.text: Seek guidance from a spiritual mentor or reflect on teachings that resonate with you.
Indulge in distractions to avoid confronting your feelings.

blocks.why: Seeking guidance aligns with the lesson's emphasis on the True Guru and divine knowledge, helping to overcome feelings of being lost. The tags are guru and naam.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, what is essential for finding the True Lord?

blocks.text: Guidance and knowledge can illuminate our path and help us find inner peace.
This lesson explores the power of chanting God's Name, the importance of humility, and the nature of devotion. It contrasts true devotion with superficial rituals and false actions.

The verses emphasize that chanting God's Name saves one from suffering. True goodness lies in performing good deeds with humility. Devotees find support in the True Name, living in bliss and serving as examples of virtue.

blocks.scenario: You receive praise for a good deed. Which action reflects the lesson?

choices.text: Acknowledge the praise with gratitude, but remain humble and focused on continuing to do good.
Let the praise inflate your ego and seek more opportunities for recognition.

blocks.why: This choice aligns with the lesson's emphasis on humility and performing good deeds without seeking personal glory. The tags are naam and humility.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, what is the support for devotees?

blocks.text: Humility and devotion can guide us towards a more meaningful life.

This lesson delves into the concept of ego (Haumai) and its pervasive influence on our actions and perceptions. It highlights the importance of the True Guru and spiritual wisdom in understanding and transcending ego.

The verses explain that without the True Guru, one cannot obtain the Lord. Ego drives many of our actions, both positive and negative. Understanding ego leads to knowing the Lord's gate, and the Guru's teachings can help overcome troubles.

blocks.scenario: You feel the need to constantly prove yourself to others. Which action reflects the lesson?

choices.text: Reflect on the root of your insecurity and seek to understand the nature of your ego.
Continue striving for external validation to boost your self-esteem.

blocks.why: This choice aligns with the lesson's emphasis on understanding ego and seeking spiritual wisdom to overcome its influence. The tags are guru and haumai.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, what is needed to understand ego?

blocks.text: Understanding and managing our ego can lead to greater self-awareness and inner peace.

This lesson focuses on the importance of selfless service (Seva), righteous living (Dharma), and gratitude. It highlights the contentment that comes from serving others and meditating on the True Lord.
The verses state that those who serve are content and meditate on the Truth. They live righteously, detached from worldly bonds. The Lord is a great giver, and creation is cherished by the Creator.

blocks.scenario: You see someone struggling with a task. Which action reflects the lesson?

choices.text: Offer your help without expecting anything in return.
Ignore their struggle, as you are busy with your own tasks.

blocks.why: This choice aligns with the lesson's emphasis on selfless service and righteous living. The tags are seva and dharma.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, what are those who serve content with?
blocks.answer: Meditating on the Truest of the True.

blocks.text: Service and gratitude can enrich our lives and connect us to something larger than ourselves.
This lesson explores the nature of Truth and the importance of the True Guru in realizing it. It contrasts true understanding with superficial knowledge and self-willed actions.

The verses state that the Truth is found through the True Guru and resides in the heart. Without the Guru, one wastes their life. True understanding comes from experiencing the Truth, not just reading about it.

blocks.scenario: You are in a debate, and you realize you are wrong. Which action reflects the lesson?

choices.text: Humbly acknowledge your mistake and seek to understand the truth.
Continue arguing your point, even though you know you are wrong.

blocks.why: This choice aligns with the lesson's emphasis on seeking Truth and recognizing the importance of the Guru's guidance. The tags are truth and guru.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, how is Truth found?

blocks.text: Seeking and embracing the Truth can lead to greater understanding and inner peace.
This lesson emphasizes the importance of God's Grace, the pursuit of Truth, and the practice of humility. It contrasts true devotion with falsehood and self-conceit.
The verses state that devotees are pleasing to God and sing His praises. Without Grace, one wanders aimlessly. Truth is the medicine for all ills, washing away sins and leading to salvation.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling proud of your accomplishments. Which action reflects the lesson?

choices.text: Acknowledge your achievements, but remain humble and grateful for the blessings in your life.
Boast about your accomplishments and seek admiration from others.

blocks.why: This choice aligns with the lesson's emphasis on humility and recognizing God's grace in our lives. The tags are grace and humility.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, what is the medicine for all?

blocks.text: Grace, truth, and humility can guide us towards a more fulfilling and meaningful life.

This lesson explores the importance of renouncing greed, the merits of selfless service, and the prevalence of falsehood in the world. It contrasts true devotion with the pursuit of wealth and superficial righteousness.

The verses state that the dust of the Saints' feet is a precious gift. False greed should be renounced, and one should meditate on the Lord. There is a famine of Truth, and falsehood prevails. True devotion involves humility and selfless service.

blocks.scenario: You are tempted to take advantage of someone for personal gain. Which action reflects the lesson?

choices.text: Resist the temptation and choose to act with honesty and integrity.
Rationalize your actions and proceed with your plan.

blocks.why: This choice aligns with the lesson's emphasis on renouncing greed and acting with truth and integrity. The tags are seva and greed.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, what should be renounced?

blocks.text: Renouncing greed and embracing truth can lead to a more fulfilling and ethical life.
The True Lord sees everything. Only what the Creator Lord does happens. Those whose karma is pre-ordained meditate on the Lord.
Our actions are observed. Ultimately, the Creator's will prevails. Some are blessed to remember the Lord.

blocks.scenario: You are planning a picnic, but the weather forecast is uncertain. Do you:

choices.text: Proceed with the picnic, trusting that the Creator's will shall prevail.
Cancel the picnic and stay home to avoid any potential rain.

blocks.why: This reflects the idea that what happens is ultimately the Creator's will, aligning with the tags 'hukam' and 'karma'.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, who sees everything?

blocks.text: Remember that actions are seen, and the Creator's will is paramount.
The creative power pervades everywhere. Your Light is in Your creatures, and Your creatures are in Your Light. Your Praise is beautiful.
The creative force is all-encompassing. There is an interconnectedness between the Divine and all beings. Praising the Divine is uplifting.

blocks.scenario: You are at a park and see people from different backgrounds enjoying themselves. Do you focus on:

choices.text: The shared joy and connection between everyone.
The differences in their clothing and activities.

blocks.why: Focusing on shared joy reflects the 'oneness' and interconnectedness described in the lesson.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, where is the Divine Light?

blocks.text: Recognize the interconnectedness and beauty of the Divine in all things.
As are the deeds done, so is the reputation one acquires. Do not play such a game that will bring you to ruin. One who stubbornly follows his own mind shall suffer.
Our actions shape our standing. Avoid actions that lead to negative consequences. Stubbornness can lead to suffering.

blocks.scenario: You are tempted to spread a rumor about a friend. Do you:

choices.text: Refrain from spreading the rumor, considering the potential harm.
Spread the rumor, as it might make you feel more important.

blocks.why: Refraining from spreading the rumor aligns with avoiding actions that lead to ruin and negative karma.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, what shapes our reputation?

blocks.text: Be mindful of your actions and avoid stubbornness to prevent suffering.

Everyone desired Truth, abided in Truth, and was merged in the Truth. With loving devotional worship, abiding in humility, salvation is attained. The Guru gives the healing ointment of spiritual wisdom.
Truth is a central desire. Devotion and humility lead to salvation. Spiritual wisdom can heal.

blocks.scenario: You are learning a new skill and feel frustrated by your mistakes. Do you:

choices.text: Approach the learning process with humility and devotion, seeking guidance.
Give up, feeling that you are not good enough.

blocks.why: Approaching learning with humility and devotion aligns with the lesson's emphasis on these qualities for attaining salvation.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, what is desired by everyone?

blocks.text: Seek truth, practice devotion and humility, and embrace spiritual wisdom.
Sweetness and humility are the essence of virtue. Everyone bows down to himself; no one bows down to another. What can be achieved by bowing the head, when the heart is impure?
Virtue lies in sweetness and humility. True humility involves recognizing others. Outward actions are meaningless without inner purity.

blocks.scenario: You receive praise for a project you worked on as part of a team. Do you:

choices.text: Acknowledge the contributions of your teammates and share the credit.
Take all the credit for yourself, emphasizing your own efforts.

blocks.why: Acknowledging the contributions of others reflects humility and recognizing others, aligning with the lesson's message.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, what is the essence of virtue?

blocks.text: Cultivate sweetness, humility, and inner purity for true virtue.
Make compassion the cotton, contentment the thread, modesty the knot and truth the twist. Believing in the Name, honor is obtained. The Lord's Praise is the true sacred thread.
Compassion, contentment, modesty, and truth are essential qualities. Honor comes from faith in the Divine Name. Praising the Lord is a true connection.

blocks.scenario: You see someone struggling to carry groceries. Do you:

choices.text: Offer to help them carry their groceries, showing compassion.
Ignore them and continue on your way.

blocks.why: Offering help demonstrates compassion, which aligns with the lesson's emphasis on compassion as an essential quality.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, what is the true sacred thread?

blocks.text: Embrace compassion, contentment, modesty, and truth, and praise the Divine Name.
One, upon whom the Merciful Lord bestows His Grace, performs His service. That servant obeys the Order of His Will. Obeying the Order, he obtains the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.
Service is performed through Divine Grace. Obeying the Divine Will is essential. This obedience leads to closeness with the Divine.

blocks.scenario: You feel inspired to volunteer at a local charity. Do you:

choices.text: Follow through with your inspiration and volunteer your time.
Dismiss the inspiration as a fleeting thought and do nothing.

blocks.why: Volunteering aligns with performing service and potentially being guided by Divine Grace.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, how does one perform service?

blocks.text: Seek Divine Grace, obey the Divine Will, and perform selfless service.
False is their capital, and false is their trade. The home of modesty and Dharma is far from them. Meditate on the True Lord. If you are pure, you will obtain the True Lord.
Falsehood leads to separation from Dharma. Inner purity is essential for connecting with the Divine. Truthfulness is valued.

blocks.scenario: You are asked to sign a document that contains misleading information. Do you:

choices.text: Refuse to sign the document, upholding truthfulness.
Sign the document to avoid conflict, even though it is misleading.

blocks.why: Refusing to sign the document upholds truthfulness and avoids participating in falsehood.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, what should one meditate on?

blocks.text: Embrace truthfulness, uphold Dharma, and strive for inner purity to connect with the Divine.
This lesson discusses purity. It says that merely washing the body does not make one pure.

The lesson explains that if one believes in impurity, it is everywhere. True purity, according to this lesson, comes from having the Lord abide within one's mind, and is washed away only by spiritual wisdom.

blocks.scenario: You are preparing food and accidentally drop some on the floor. Do you:

choices.text: Clean it up and remember that life exists everywhere.
Ritually purify the entire kitchen.

blocks.why: This choice aligns with the lesson's emphasis on spiritual wisdom over ritualistic cleansing, connecting to the tags 'maya' and 'spiritual_wisdom'.

blocks.question: According to this lesson, what truly makes someone pure?
blocks.answer: Having the Lord abide within their mind.

blocks.text: True purity comes from within.
This lesson speaks about the impurities of the mind, tongue, eyes, and ears. It also discusses duality.

The lesson states that greed, falsehood, gazing upon another's wealth, and listening to slander are impurities. It suggests that all impurity comes from doubt and attachment to duality, while birth and death are subject to the Lord's Will. Those who understand the Lord are not stained by impurity.

blocks.scenario: A friend tells you a rumor about someone else. Do you:

choices.text: Refrain from listening and change the subject.
Listen intently and share your own opinions.

blocks.why: Choosing not to listen to slander aligns with the lesson's message about avoiding impurity, connecting to the tags 'greed' and 'duality'.

blocks.question: What is identified as the impurity of the mind?

blocks.text: Avoid negativity to stay pure.
This lesson discusses the importance of chanting the Naam. It also speaks about the role of women.

The lesson suggests that a mouth that does not chant the Naam is impure. It also emphasizes that women are essential and should not be considered bad, as all are born from them. Only the True Lord is without a woman.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling grateful for your life. Do you:

choices.text: Silently offer a prayer of thanks.
Complain about minor inconveniences.

blocks.why: Offering thanks aligns with the lesson's emphasis on praising the Lord and chanting the Naam, connecting to the tags 'naam' and 'detachment'.

blocks.question: According to this lesson, what kind of mouth is blessed?
blocks.answer: A mouth that praises the Lord continually.

blocks.text: Remember to be thankful.
This lesson discusses the consequences of speaking insipid words. It also speaks about those who embrace love for the Lord.

The lesson suggests that speaking insipid words leads to an insipid body and mind, and ultimately punishment. Those who embrace love for the Lord, and do not care for anything else, are considered good. Everyone will be judged in the Lord's Court.

blocks.scenario: You are tempted to gossip about a friend. Do you:

choices.text: Refrain from speaking and think of something positive to say instead.
Share the gossip, but promise not to reveal your source.

blocks.why: Choosing to refrain from negative speech aligns with the lesson's emphasis on avoiding insipid words, connecting to the tags 'ego' and 'detachment'.

blocks.question: What happens to the body and mind when insipid words are spoken?

blocks.text: Speak kindly and truthfully.
This lesson questions love that clings to duality. It also speaks about serving the Lord.

The lesson suggests that true love is being immersed in absorption, not clinging to duality. Serving the Lord brings peace, and one should avoid evil deeds. One should act in a way that does not lead to losing with the Lord.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling upset because a friend didn't invite you to a party. Do you:

choices.text: Reflect on your own actions and focus on serving others.
Confront your friend and demand an explanation.

blocks.why: Focusing on serving others aligns with the lesson's emphasis on serving the Lord and detaching from duality, connecting to the tags 'duality' and 'seva'.

blocks.question: What is obtained by serving the Lord?

blocks.text: Serve others and find peace.
This lesson speaks about the importance of eliminating self-conceit. It also discusses the consequences of practicing falsehood.

The lesson suggests that service performed without self-conceit is honored. Practicing falsehood only yields falsehood, while praising the Lord leads to blossoming forth. One should offer humble prayers instead of issuing commands to the Lord.

blocks.scenario: You are asked to help with a task you find unpleasant. Do you:

choices.text: Humbly offer your assistance without complaint.
Complain about the task and try to get out of it.

blocks.why: Offering assistance without complaint aligns with the lesson's emphasis on humility and eliminating self-conceit, connecting to the tags 'humility' and 'ego'.

blocks.question: What is obtained through the Lord's praise?

blocks.text: Be humble and truthful.
This lesson speaks about the importance of obeying the Will of the Master. It also discusses offering prayers instead of issuing commands.
The lesson suggests that a servant should obey the Will of the Master, not claim equality. One should celebrate the Lord from whom we receive nourishment. Instead of issuing commands, offer prayers.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling frustrated with a situation you cannot control. Do you:

choices.text: Offer a prayer for guidance and acceptance.
Demand that things go your way.

blocks.why: Offering a prayer aligns with the lesson's emphasis on humility and accepting the Lord's Will, connecting to the tags 'humility' and 'hukam'.

blocks.question: What should one offer instead of issuing commands to the Lord?

blocks.text: Accept what you cannot change.
This lesson speaks about receiving gifts from the Lord. It also discusses the Lord's creation and care for it.

The lesson suggests that the most wonderful gift is received when the Lord is pleased. The Lord's limits are unknown, and He creates and destroys. He acts and causes us to act, and He takes care of His creation.

blocks.scenario: You receive an unexpected compliment from a stranger. Do you:

choices.text: Acknowledge it with gratitude, recognizing it as a gift.
Dismiss it as insincere or unimportant.

blocks.why: Acknowledging the compliment with gratitude aligns with the lesson's emphasis on recognizing gifts from the Lord, connecting to the tags 'kirpa' and 'oneness'.

blocks.question: According to this lesson, who takes care of the creation?

blocks.text: Be grateful for all you receive.
The verses describe how the Creator fashions and fills everything. Some receive blessings, while others face challenges. Ultimately, everything happens according to His will and grace.

The Creator is all-powerful and all-encompassing. He shapes our lives, giving some comfort and others hardship.  Everything is within His control, and there is no other besides Him.  He does whatever He wills.

blocks.scenario: You are planning a picnic, but the weather forecast changes suddenly.  It might rain.

choices.text: Accept the change and find an indoor activity, understanding that things don't always go as planned.
Become frustrated and try to force the picnic to happen, despite the weather.

blocks.why: This relates to the tags because accepting the change reflects understanding Hukam (divine order) and recognizing the Oneness of the Creator's will.

blocks.question: According to the verses, who is in control of everything?

blocks.text: Recognizing the Creator's will can bring peace in the face of life's changes.
These verses explore the cycle of birth and death and the bonds that keep us trapped.  Seeking guidance can help us break free from fear and doubt.  Realizing the self can lead to peace.

Our actions (karma) influence our experiences in the cycle of birth and death.  Attachment to Maya (illusion) and lack of self-awareness perpetuate doubt.  Seeking guidance and understanding can lead to liberation.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling anxious about a future event and unsure of how it will turn out.

choices.text: Reflect on your past actions and seek guidance to understand the situation better, reducing your anxiety.
Become consumed by worry and avoid seeking any understanding or guidance.

blocks.why: This relates to the tags because seeking guidance addresses doubt and helps break free from the cycle of negative karma and attachment to Maya.

blocks.question: What perpetuates doubt, according to the verses?
blocks.answer: Attachment to Maya and lack of self-awareness.

blocks.text: Seeking guidance and understanding can help us navigate life's challenges with less fear and doubt.

These verses discuss freedom from birth and death through love and detachment.  Just as a reflection merges back when its container breaks, the soul merges with the Divine.  External appearances do not define a saint.

The soul is inherently free from the cycle of reincarnation.  By letting go of the illusion of birth and death, one can remain absorbed in the Lord's Love.  True devotion is not found in outward displays.

blocks.scenario: You see someone performing elaborate religious rituals, but they are unkind to others.

choices.text: Remember that true devotion is about love and detachment, not just outward displays.
Assume they are very spiritual because of their rituals.

blocks.why: This relates to the tags because it emphasizes detachment from superficiality and focuses on the essence of love, which leads to freedom from reincarnation.

blocks.question: According to the verses, what is the key to being free from birth and death?
blocks.answer: Being absorbed in the Lord's Love.

blocks.text: True spirituality lies in love and detachment, not just external practices.
These verses critique those who appear outwardly pure but engage in harmful actions.  True detachment involves inner transformation, not just external rituals.  Ego and sin lead to suffering.

Outward displays of purity are meaningless if one continues to engage in sinful deeds.  Ego and self-conceit lead to a cycle of suffering.  True detachment requires inner transformation and a rejection of harmful actions.

blocks.scenario: You notice someone who is very vocal about their religious practices, but you also see them gossiping and judging others.

choices.text: Recognize that true spirituality is about inner transformation and detachment from ego, not just outward displays.
Assume they are a good person because of their religious talk.

blocks.why: This relates to the tags because it highlights the importance of detachment from ego and sin, emphasizing that true spirituality goes beyond outward appearances.

blocks.question: According to the verses, what is more important than outward displays of purity?
blocks.answer: Inner transformation and detachment from ego.

blocks.text: Focus on inner transformation and detachment from ego, rather than just outward appearances.
These verses describe the peace and contentment that come from meeting the True Guru.  One who is guided by the Guru is not reincarnated again.  Maya (illusion) loses its power.
Meeting the True Guru brings an end to the cycle of reincarnation.  The Guru provides comfort and guidance, filling one with contentment.  When one is connected to the Divine, Maya loses its hold.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling lost and uncertain about your path in life.

choices.text: Seek guidance from a trusted mentor or spiritual teacher to find clarity and direction.
Continue to wander aimlessly without seeking any guidance.

blocks.why: This relates to the tags because seeking guidance from a Guru can lead to contentment and freedom from the cycle of reincarnation.

blocks.question: According to the verses, what happens when one meets the True Guru?

blocks.text: Seeking guidance can bring peace, contentment, and freedom from the cycle of reincarnation.
These verses express devotion to the Divine Father and the importance of the Guru.  The Guru helps overcome negative influences and fills one with love.  Through the Guru, one can know everything.

The Divine Father is the source of life and love.  The Guru guides us to overcome negative influences and connect with the Divine.  Through devotion and the Guru's grace, we can gain understanding and knowledge.

blocks.scenario: You are struggling with negative thoughts and emotions.

choices.text: Seek guidance from a spiritual mentor or practice meditation to connect with the Divine and overcome these negative influences.
Allow the negative thoughts and emotions to consume you without seeking any help.

blocks.why: This relates to the tags because seeking guidance and connecting with the Divine through devotion can help overcome negative influences and foster love.

blocks.question: According to the verses, who helps us overcome negative influences?

blocks.text: Devotion and guidance can help us overcome negativity and connect with the Divine.

These verses use symbolic language to describe Maya (illusion) and the importance of wisdom.  Maya is portrayed as a shameless queen who deceives and destroys.  Discriminating wisdom can cut through this illusion.

Maya, or illusion, is a powerful force that can lead to destruction.  It is present everywhere and deceives many.  However, with discriminating wisdom, one can see through the illusion and break free from its grasp.

blocks.scenario: You are tempted to make a purchase you cannot afford because it is trendy and everyone else has it.

choices.text: Use wisdom to evaluate whether the purchase is truly necessary or just a fleeting desire driven by Maya (illusion).
Give in to the temptation and make the purchase without considering the consequences.

blocks.why: This relates to the tags because it highlights the importance of wisdom in overcoming the allure of Maya and avoiding ego-driven decisions.

blocks.question: According to the verses, what can cut through the illusion of Maya?

blocks.text: Cultivate wisdom to see through illusions and make choices that align with your true values.

These verses emphasize the importance of wisdom and detachment from illusion.  The Divine is described as the source of wisdom and the protector of those who are detached.  The company of saints is valued.
True wisdom comes from the Divine.  Detachment from Maya (illusion) allows the Divine to protect us.  While Maya may be appealing to many, it is an enemy of those who seek truth and enlightenment.

blocks.scenario: You are surrounded by people who are focused on material possessions and worldly success.

choices.text: Maintain your focus on wisdom and detachment, seeking the company of those who share your values.
Get caught up in the pursuit of material possessions and worldly success.

blocks.why: This relates to the tags because it emphasizes the importance of wisdom, detachment from Maya, and seeking the company of those who support spiritual growth (sangat).

blocks.question: According to the verses, who is the enemy of the Saints?

blocks.text: Seek wisdom, practice detachment, and surround yourself with supportive company on your spiritual journey.
Meditate on the Lord. What can death do to one whose tongue loves the Lord's Name?
This reminds us to focus on the divine. By loving the Lord's name, one can overcome fear. Even those with worldly knowledge and power will face death.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling anxious about an upcoming challenge.

choices.text: Quietly remember the Lord's name.
Focus only on the details of the challenge.

blocks.why: Remembering the Lord's name can help overcome anxiety, aligning with the tags 'naam' and 'remembrance'.

blocks.question: What can protect you from death, according to this passage?

blocks.text: Remembering the Lord can help overcome fear.
The Vedas and other scriptures cannot save anyone. Meditate on the Lord, and eliminate birth and death.
This suggests that worldly knowledge alone is insufficient. Meditating on the Lord can help one transcend the cycle of birth and death.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling overwhelmed by studying many books.

choices.text: Take a break to meditate on the Lord.
Keep studying harder.

blocks.why: Taking a break to meditate aligns with the tags 'naam' and 'death' by suggesting a focus beyond worldly knowledge.

blocks.question: What can eliminate birth and death?

blocks.text: Meditation can help one transcend the cycle of life and death.
The ant has eaten the mountain. Listen to this mystery of the Shabad.
This uses symbolic language to convey a deeper truth. The mystery of the Shabad suggests that something small can overcome something large.

blocks.scenario: You feel like your problems are too big to solve.

choices.text: Remember that even small actions can overcome big challenges.
Give up because the problems are too big.

blocks.why: Remembering that small actions can overcome big challenges aligns with the tags 'shabad' and 'wisdom' by suggesting a deeper understanding.

blocks.question: What ate the mountain?

blocks.text: Small actions can overcome big challenges.
He makes spiritual wisdom his patched coat, and meditation his needle. He walks on the Guru's Path.
This describes a path of spiritual practice. It suggests using wisdom and meditation as tools for detachment and following the Guru's path.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling attached to material possessions.

choices.text: Reflect on spiritual wisdom and meditate.
Buy more things to feel better.

blocks.why: Reflecting on spiritual wisdom and meditating aligns with the tags 'gian', 'shabad', and 'detachment' by suggesting a focus beyond material possessions.

blocks.question: What should you use as a needle?

blocks.text: Spiritual wisdom and meditation can help with detachment.
He makes compassion his shovel, and places love within his heart. If God grants His Grace, He bestows the insignia of Truth.
This emphasizes the importance of compassion and love. Divine grace can lead to truth.

blocks.scenario: You see someone struggling.

choices.text: Offer help with compassion.
Ignore them and continue with your day.

blocks.why: Offering help with compassion aligns with the tags 'compassion', 'love', and 'grace' by suggesting a focus on helping others.

blocks.question: What should you place within your heart?

blocks.text: Compassion and love are important virtues.
If God wished me to be a Muslim, it would be cut off by itself. She is the other half of a man's body, and she does not leave him, so he remains a Hindu.
This questions the importance of religious rituals. It suggests that God's will is paramount and that men and women are interconnected.

blocks.scenario: You are arguing about religious differences.

choices.text: Remember that we are all interconnected.
Insist that your religion is the only right one.

blocks.why: Remembering that we are all interconnected aligns with the tags 'duality' and 'oneness' by suggesting a focus on unity.

blocks.question: What is the other half of a man's body?

blocks.text: We are all interconnected.
Remember the Lord, and stop oppressing others. Meditate on the Name of that Lord.
This advises to remember the Lord and to treat others with kindness. It suggests that remembering the Lord's name is important.

blocks.scenario: You are tempted to be unkind to someone.

choices.text: Remember the Lord and treat them with kindness.
Be unkind to them.

blocks.why: Remembering the Lord and treating them with kindness aligns with the tags 'remembrance' and 'advice' by suggesting a focus on kindness.

blocks.question: What should you stop doing?

blocks.text: Remember the Lord and treat others with kindness.
When the pitcher of the body breaks, no one cares for you at all. This human suffers torture and the Messenger of Death will not leave him alone.
This describes the impermanence of the body and the inevitability of death. It suggests that worldly attachments are fleeting.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling anxious about death.

choices.text: Remember that the body is impermanent.
Try not to think about it.

blocks.why: Remembering that the body is impermanent aligns with the tags 'death', 'maya', and 'fear' by suggesting a focus on impermanence.

blocks.question: What breaks?

blocks.text: The body is impermanent.
Churn the churn of the Lord, so that the essence, the butter, may not be lost. Make your body the churning jar, and use the stick of your mind to churn it. Gather the curds of the Word.
This advises us to focus our minds on the Lord. Just as churning milk produces butter, focusing our minds allows us to extract the essence of the Word. This essence should be gathered and cherished.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling distracted and unable to focus on your daily tasks. You remember this teaching.

choices.text: Take a few moments to quietly reflect on the Lord.
Continue with your tasks, hoping the feeling will pass.

blocks.why: Reflecting on the Lord is like churning, helping to extract the essence of the Word, aligning with the tags of remembrance and devotion.

blocks.question: What should you use as the churning stick?

blocks.text: Focusing your mind on the Lord helps you extract the essence of the Word.
The churning of the Lord is to reflect upon Him within your mind. By Guru's Grace, the Ambrosial Nectar flows into us. If the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, one is carried across.
Reflecting on the Lord within your mind is a form of churning. Through the Guru's grace, we receive divine nectar. The Lord's grace helps us cross over difficulties.

blocks.scenario: You are facing a difficult challenge and feeling overwhelmed. You remember this teaching.

choices.text: Reflect on the Lord and seek the Guru's grace.
Try to solve the problem on your own without any reflection.

blocks.why: Reflecting on the Lord and seeking Guru's grace aligns with the tags of grace, guru, and remembrance, offering a path through difficulties.

blocks.question: What flows into us by Guru's Grace?

blocks.text: Reflecting on the Lord and seeking Guru's grace can help you overcome challenges.
The One Lord is pervading everywhere; there is no other second. When one comes to understand, he forgets his preaching, ranting and raving, and arguing.
The Lord is present in all things. True understanding leads to the end of unnecessary arguments and preaching. It brings a sense of unity.

blocks.scenario: You find yourself in a heated debate with someone. You remember this teaching.

choices.text: Recognize the Lord's presence in the other person and try to understand their perspective.
Continue arguing to prove your point.
