blocks.text: Detaching from worldly anxieties and seeking the Lord's presence through the Company of the Holy can bring lasting peace and freedom.
This passage emphasizes the impermanence of worldly possessions and the importance of chanting the Lord's Name. It highlights the value of the Saadh Sangat and waking up to the reality of life.

These verses remind us that material things are fleeting and only the Lord's Name accompanies us.  Without the Saadh Sangat, the world is false, and without the Lord's Name, there is no peace.  Joining the Saadh Sangat allows one to go to the house of the Lord with honor.

blocks.scenario: You are spending a lot of time pursuing material success, neglecting your spiritual well-being.

choices.text: Re-evaluate your priorities and dedicate time to prayer, reflection, and connecting with a spiritual community.
Continue pursuing material success, hoping it will eventually bring you happiness.

blocks.why: Re-evaluating priorities and connecting with a spiritual community aligns with the tags of 'sangat' and 'detachment' from 'maya'.

blocks.question: What is the only thing that goes along with us after death?
blocks.answer: The Name of the Lord of the Universe.

blocks.text: Remembering the impermanence of worldly things and seeking the Saadh Sangat can help us wake up to the true reality of life.

This passage expresses gratitude for the Lord's grace and the blessing of the Saadh Sangat. It emphasizes the transformative power of worshipping in the Company of the Holy and chanting the Lord's Name.

These verses describe how the Lord's blessings lead to being pulled out of the mud and blessed with the Saadh Sangat.  Worshipping in the Saadh Sangat burns away sins and suffering.  Chanting the Lord's Name fills the mind and body, and whoever the Lord unites with is filled with all virtues.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling stuck in negative patterns and struggling to overcome bad habits.

choices.text: Seek guidance and support from a spiritual community and dedicate yourself to prayer and chanting.
Try to overcome your challenges alone, relying on willpower and self-discipline.

blocks.why: Seeking guidance from a spiritual community aligns with the 'sangat' tag and offers a path to burning away sins and suffering.

blocks.question: What happens to those who worship the Lord in the Saadh Sangat?
blocks.answer: All their sins and sufferings are burnt away.

blocks.text: Seeking the Lord's grace and worshipping in the Company of the Holy can help us overcome negative patterns and live a virtuous life.

This passage emphasizes the Lord's all-encompassing presence and the importance of aligning with His will. It contrasts the wisdom of the spiritually enlightened with the misguided path of the self-willed.

These verses state that the Lord created all and pervades within all.  Whatever pleases the Lord happens, and all act as He causes them to act.  The spiritually wise one has conquered all, while the self-willed are led astray by greed and ego.  Those who give their heads to the Creator find peace.

blocks.scenario: You are facing a difficult decision and unsure of the best course of action.

choices.text: Reflect on your values, seek guidance through prayer, and trust that the Lord's will shall prevail.
Rely solely on your own intellect and desires, pursuing the path that seems most advantageous.

blocks.why: Seeking guidance through prayer aligns with the concept of 'hukam' and trusting in the Lord's will.

blocks.question: According to this passage, what leads the self-willed astray?

blocks.text: Aligning with the Lord's will and seeking spiritual wisdom can lead to peace and fulfillment, while self-will leads to misguided actions.

This passage emphasizes the Lord's role as the giver of all and the importance of serving the Guru. It highlights the blessedness of those who are pleasing to the True Lord and the transformative power of seva (selfless service).

These verses state that the Lord is the wealth of all and the great giver.  Those who are pleasing to Him are accepted and blessed.  Gurmukhs are pleasing to the True Lord and are judged to be true.  Serving the Guru and maintaining the Fear of God leads to becoming like Him.

blocks.scenario: You are looking for ways to deepen your spiritual connection.

choices.text: Engage in selfless service to others and dedicate yourself to serving the Guru's teachings.
Focus solely on personal meditation and introspection, neglecting the needs of others.

blocks.why: Engaging in selfless service aligns with the 'seva' tag and the passage's emphasis on serving the Guru.

blocks.question: What are Gurmukhs pleasing to?

blocks.text: Serving the Guru and engaging in selfless service can lead to a deeper spiritual connection and a life of purpose.
This lesson explores the greatness of the Divine and the importance of faith. We will reflect on the idea that the Divine is beyond comparison and that serving the Divine brings peace.

The verses emphasize that the Divine is unique and without equal. Serving the Divine leads to peace, and without pre-ordained karma, one cannot obtain blessings. The verses also touch on the importance of eliminating self-conceit to find the True Guru.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling overwhelmed by a difficult situation at work. You remember the teaching that serving brings peace.

choices.text: Take a moment to reflect on the Divine and offer help to a colleague.
Focus solely on your own tasks and avoid any distractions.

blocks.why: Reflecting on the Divine and helping others aligns with the tags of oneness, humility, and faith.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, what does serving the Divine bring?

blocks.text: Remember, recognizing the Divine's greatness and acting with humility can bring peace.
This lesson focuses on the importance of meditating on the Divine and the blessings that come from it. We will explore how the Lord's Grace can eradicate pain and suffering.

The verses state that meditating on the Divine brings peace and comfort. The Lord's Grace removes pain and suffering, and one who is devoted is saved. The tongue should savor the Lord's Name, and the Gurmukh chants the Lord's Name with love.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling anxious about an upcoming presentation. You remember the teaching that meditating on the Divine brings peace.

choices.text: Take a few minutes to meditate and remember the Lord as the Giver of Peace.
Continue to worry and rehearse the presentation repeatedly.

blocks.why: Meditating on the Divine aligns with the tags of naam, peace, and grace.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, what is the Lord described as?

blocks.text: Remember, meditating on the Divine and seeking His Grace can bring peace and comfort in times of anxiety.
This lesson explores the concept that the Divine is the Master and that everything happens according to His Will. We will reflect on the importance of surrendering to the Divine's Hukam.

The verses emphasize that the Divine is the Master, servant, and devotee. Everything happens as He wills, and He guides individuals on different paths. By Guru's Grace, one can sing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord and receive the Name as charity.

blocks.scenario: You had planned a picnic, but it started raining unexpectedly. You remember the teaching that everything happens according to His Will.

choices.text: Accept the change of plans and find an alternative indoor activity.
Become frustrated and complain about the weather ruining your plans.

blocks.why: Accepting the situation aligns with the tags of oneness, hukam, and guru.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, who is the Master, servant, and devotee?

blocks.text: Remember, surrendering to the Divine's Will and accepting what comes can bring peace and understanding.
This lesson explores the concept that the Divine is the Creator and that everything belongs to Him. We will reflect on the importance of detaching from Maya and worldly attachments.

The verses emphasize that the Divine is the doer of everything. Rituals and attachments are entanglements, and the world is engrossed in them. By merging with the Will of the True Guru, one can break free from these bonds and see that everything belongs to the Creator.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling anxious about losing your job. You remember the teaching that everything belongs to the Creator.

choices.text: Trust in the Divine's plan and focus on doing your best in the present moment.
Become consumed with worry and fear about the future.

blocks.why: Trusting in the Divine aligns with the tags of oneness, maya, and attachment.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, what happens when the blind merge with the Will of the True Guru?

blocks.text: Remember, detaching from worldly attachments and trusting in the Divine can bring peace and understanding.
This lesson explores the concept that the Divine is the Creator and that He blesses all with His Grace. We will reflect on the importance of serving the Divine and drinking in His Ambrosial Nectar.

The verses emphasize that the Divine created the Universe and blesses all. As Gurmukh, we drink in His Ambrosial Nectar. The Gurmukhs serve God and are steeped in the Love of the True Lord. By His Grace, He unites us in His Union.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling grateful for a positive experience in your life. You remember the teaching that the Creator blessed all with His blessings.

choices.text: Express gratitude to the Divine and share your joy with others.
Keep the positive experience to yourself and avoid sharing it with others.

blocks.why: Expressing gratitude aligns with the tags of oneness, gurmukh, and grace.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, what do the Gurmukhs drink in?

blocks.text: Remember, recognizing the Divine's Grace and expressing gratitude can bring joy and fulfillment.

This lesson explores the concept that the Divine is all-encompassing and that He grants pleasure and pain. We will reflect on the importance of living in the Fear of God and avoiding the ways of the self-willed manmukh.

The verses emphasize that the Divine is all goodness and causes us to act. Living in the Fear of God and piercing the heart with the Word of the Shabad brings peace. The self-willed manmukh is attached to Maya and practices falsehood, leading to dishonor.

blocks.scenario: You are tempted to gossip about a colleague at work. You remember the teaching to live in the Fear of God.

choices.text: Refrain from gossiping and instead offer a kind word to your colleague.
Join in the gossip and share your own negative opinions.

blocks.why: Refraining from gossip aligns with the tags of oneness, fear, and avoiding the ways of the manmukh.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, what should one abandon?

blocks.text: Remember, living in the Fear of God and avoiding falsehood can lead to peace and honor.
This lesson explores the concept that the Divine is the Creator of all and that He is the boatman who ferries us across the world-ocean. We will reflect on the importance of service to the True Guru.

The verses emphasize that the Divine created everything and is the ocean and the sea. Service to the True Guru with a sincere mind leads to the treasure of the Naam and freedom from anxiety. The True Guru is the boat in this Dark Age, and one who becomes Gurmukh crosses over.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling overwhelmed by the challenges in your life. You remember the teaching about service to the True Guru.

choices.text: Offer selfless service to others and seek guidance from the Guru's teachings.
Withdraw from others and focus solely on your own problems.

blocks.why: Offering selfless service aligns with the tags of oneness, seva, and guru.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, what is fruitful?

blocks.text: Remember, service to the True Guru with a sincere mind can lead to peace and liberation.

This lesson explores the concept that the Divine is the Destroyer of sins and that He is the basis of all illusion. We will reflect on the importance of serving the True Guru and embracing love for the Lord's Name.

The verses emphasize that the Divine transforms metal into gold and is the Destroyer of sins. Serving the True Guru is essential, and those who embrace love for the Lord's Name reform their lives and redeem their generations. Without serving the True Guru, deeds are only chains binding the soul.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling regretful about a past mistake. You remember the teaching about the Divine being the Destroyer of sins.

choices.text: Seek forgiveness from the Divine and commit to learning from your mistake.
Dwell on your mistake and allow it to consume you with guilt.

blocks.why: Seeking forgiveness aligns with the tags of guru, naam, and love.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, what does serving the True Guru lead to?

blocks.text: Remember, serving the True Guru and embracing love for the Divine can lead to redemption and liberation.
This lesson discusses the importance of good deeds and truth. It contrasts these with negative qualities like self-conceit and falsehood.

The verses suggest that good deeds and truth are like a distillery for creating the 'wine of Truth.' Conversely, self-conceit is likened to a harmful wine that leads to corruption. Spiritual wisdom and praise are the true sustenance.

blocks.scenario: You are at a social gathering. Some people are gossiping and exaggerating stories, while others are sharing thoughtful insights and offering support.

choices.text: Join the group sharing thoughtful insights.
Join the group gossiping and exaggerating stories.

blocks.why: Choosing thoughtful insights aligns with the lesson's emphasis on truth and good deeds, contrasting with the falsehood of gossip. This connects to the tags 'truth' and 'ego'.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, what should good deeds and truth be used for?
blocks.answer: To make the most excellent wine of Truth.

blocks.text: Cultivating good deeds and truth can lead to inner peace and well-being.
This lesson focuses on the importance of the Society of Saints and love for the Lord. It emphasizes how these can purify and transform us.

The verses describe how meeting with the Society of Saints fills one with the Lord's Love, wiping away corruptions. The Lord is seen as the creator and sustainer of all, and true evening prayer is that which brings the Lord to mind.

blocks.scenario: You have a free evening. You could either spend it alone, or join a community gathering focused on spiritual reflection and service.

choices.text: Join the community gathering.
Spend the evening alone.

blocks.why: Joining the community gathering aligns with the lesson's emphasis on 'sangat' (the Society of Saints) and its purifying effects. This is tied to the 'sangat' tag.

blocks.question: What fills the cup of the Lord's Love when meeting with the Society of Saints?

blocks.text: Connecting with others in a spirit of love and devotion can bring about inner cleansing.
This lesson explores the concept of the Divine as the essence of everything. It highlights the importance of remembering the Lord's Name and seeking guidance from the True Guru.

The verses describe the Divine as both the supreme essence and the essence of all. Remembering the Lord's Name in the company of the holy is emphasized, while bodies that do not remember the Lord are considered cursed.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling lost and disconnected. You could either continue searching for external solutions, or turn inward and focus on remembering the Divine.

choices.text: Turn inward and focus on remembering the Divine.
Continue searching for external solutions.

blocks.why: Turning inward aligns with the lesson's emphasis on remembering the Lord's Name ('naam') and finding satisfaction within. This connects to the 'naam' tag.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, what happens to a body that does not remember the Lord's Name?
blocks.answer: It shall be reduced to dust.

blocks.text: Remembering the Divine can bring a sense of connection and purpose.
This lesson emphasizes the importance of chanting God's Name and seeking enlightenment through the Guru. It contrasts this with 'blind deeds' performed without spiritual guidance.
The verses suggest that the Creator is present in all sacred places. Remembering God and nurturing the body are important. Without the True Guru, the world is blind and performs blind deeds.

blocks.scenario: You are faced with a difficult decision. You could either make the decision based solely on your own limited understanding, or seek guidance from a trusted mentor or spiritual teacher.

choices.text: Seek guidance from a trusted mentor or spiritual teacher.
Make the decision based solely on your own limited understanding.

blocks.why: Seeking guidance aligns with the lesson's emphasis on the Guru and avoiding 'blind deeds.' This connects to the 'guru' tag.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, what should abide within your heart?
blocks.answer: The Lotus Feet of the Lord.

blocks.text: Seeking guidance and remembering the Divine can help us make wise choices.
This lesson focuses on following the Will of the True Guru and the importance of the Lord's Name. It contrasts this with the allure of false pleasures.

The verses state that the True Guru commands us to meditate on the Lord. The Lord's Name is described as Ambrosial Nectar. The lesson warns against false wine that leads to madness and forgetting the Lord.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling stressed and overwhelmed. You could either seek temporary relief through unhealthy habits, or turn to spiritual practices and remembering the Divine.

choices.text: Turn to spiritual practices and remembering the Divine.
Seek temporary relief through unhealthy habits.

blocks.why: Turning to spiritual practices aligns with the lesson's emphasis on the Lord's Name ('naam') and following the True Guru, contrasting with false pleasures. This connects to the 'naam' tag.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, what is the Name of the Lord?

blocks.text: Following the True Guru and remembering the Divine can bring lasting peace and well-being.
This lesson discusses the importance of the Guru's Grace and overcoming duality. It emphasizes praising the Lord and detaching from worldly attachments.
The verses suggest that everything happens by the Lord's doing. Praising the Lord brings everything, and the Lord bestows mercy. The lesson encourages destroying the love of duality.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling envious of someone else's success. You could either dwell on your own perceived shortcomings, or focus on praising the Divine and being grateful for what you have.

choices.text: Focus on praising the Divine and being grateful for what you have.
Dwell on your own perceived shortcomings.

blocks.why: Focusing on praising the Divine aligns with the lesson's emphasis on praising the Lord and detaching from duality. This connects to the 'duality' tag.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, what destroys the pile of the love of duality?

blocks.text: Praising the Divine and detaching from worldly attachments can bring inner peace and contentment.
This lesson explores the concept of death and the importance of remembering the Lord's Name. It emphasizes understanding the Lord's Will and seeking guidance from the Guru.

The verses suggest that if one does not forget the Lord, death will be easy. The world is terrified of death, but by Guru's Grace, one can understand the Lord's Will. The Lord causes His Name to be chanted.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling anxious about the future and the unknown. You could either dwell on your fears, or focus on remembering the Divine and trusting in the Lord's Will.

choices.text: Focus on remembering the Divine and trusting in the Lord's Will.
Dwell on your fears.

blocks.why: Focusing on remembering the Divine aligns with the lesson's emphasis on the Lord's Name ('naam') and understanding the Lord's Will. This connects to the 'death' tag, as it addresses fear of the unknown.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, what happens when the Lord Master becomes merciful?
blocks.answer: The Lord Himself causes His Name to be chanted.

blocks.text: Remembering the Divine and trusting in the Lord's Will can bring peace and courage in the face of uncertainty.
This lesson focuses on the wealth of the Naam and the importance of humility. It contrasts this with the cycle of death and rebirth caused by egotism.

The verses describe the Naam as a wealth that brings peace and eternal profit. The Lord is present everywhere, both within and outside. Egotism leads to repeated death, while remembering the Lord brings enlightenment.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling proud of your accomplishments. You could either boast about them to others, or remain humble and grateful for the blessings you have received.

choices.text: Remain humble and grateful for the blessings you have received.
Boast about them to others.

blocks.why: Remaining humble aligns with the lesson's emphasis on overcoming egotism and obtaining the Name of the Lord through Grace. This connects to the 'ego' tag.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, what is the wealth that brings peace?

blocks.text: Cultivating humility and focusing on the Naam can lead to lasting peace and freedom from the cycle of rebirth.
From the beginning, it has been the Will of the Lord Master that He cannot be remembered without the True Guru. Meeting the True Guru, fears of birth and death depart.

Remembering the Lord with every breath is important.  The True Guru helps us realize the Lord's presence within.  When we remember the Lord, fears disappear and we can obtain eternal life through His Mercy.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling anxious about an upcoming change in your life. You can either dwell on your fears, or try to connect with the True Guru.

choices.text: Remember the Lord and seek guidance.
Let your fears consume you.

blocks.why: Remembering the Lord and seeking guidance aligns with the teaching that fears depart when we remember the Lord with the help of the True Guru. This relates to the tags 'hukam', 'guru', and 'fear'.

blocks.question: According to this passage, what happens when we remember the Lord with every breath?
blocks.answer: Fears of birth and death depart.

blocks.text: Remembering the Lord with the help of the True Guru can help overcome fears.
Everything is in Your power; the devotees have perfect faith in Him. Everything comes by the Lord's Will, and everything goes by the Lord's Will.
This passage emphasizes the power of the Lord and the importance of faith.  Everything happens according to His Will.  A Gurmukh understands the Lord's Command through His Mercy.

blocks.scenario: You are facing a difficult situation and feel helpless. You can either try to control everything yourself, or trust in the Lord's Will.

choices.text: Have faith and trust in the Lord's Will.
Try to control everything yourself.

blocks.why: Having faith and trusting in the Lord's Will aligns with the teaching that everything is in His power and comes by His Will. This relates to the tags 'faith', 'hukam', and 'guru'.

blocks.question: According to this passage, who understands the Hukam of the Lord's Command?

blocks.text: Having faith and trusting in the Lord's Will can bring peace in difficult times.
He alone is a Yogi who, as Gurmukh, obtains the Naam; the Lord is manifest in his heart. He Himself created the creatures, and You alone are the Giver.
The Gurmukh obtains the Naam, and the Lord is manifest in his heart. The Lord created and supports all beings. He is the ultimate Giver.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling disconnected from the world around you. You can either focus on outward appearances, or seek the Naam within.

choices.text: Seek the Naam within.
Focus on outward appearances.

blocks.why: Seeking the Naam within aligns with the teaching that the Gurmukh obtains the Naam and the Lord is manifest in his heart. This relates to the tags 'naam', 'gurmukh', and 'oneness'.

blocks.question: According to this passage, who obtains the Naam?

blocks.text: Seeking the Naam within can help connect with the Lord and the world around us.
I am a sacrifice to Your Name, O Lord Master. His Name is ambrosial nectar. You dwell with everyone.
This passage expresses devotion to the Lord and His Name.  The Lord's Name is described as ambrosial nectar.  Although the Lord dwells with everyone, He may not always be visible.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling distant from the Lord. You can either focus on the separation, or remember that He dwells with everyone.

choices.text: Remember that He dwells with everyone.
Focus on the separation.

blocks.why: Remembering that the Lord dwells with everyone aligns with the teaching that He is present, even when not visible. This relates to the tags 'devotion', 'naam', and 'love'.

blocks.question: According to this passage, what is the Lord's Name?

blocks.text: Remembering that the Lord dwells with everyone can help bridge the feeling of distance.
My mind is cleansed of doubt when I praise You and pray to You. The virtuous bride enjoys her Husband Lord.
Praising and praying to the Lord can cleanse the mind of doubt.  A virtuous soul enjoys the Lord. The Lord is loving and playful.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling doubtful and uncertain. You can either dwell on your doubts, or praise and pray to the Lord.

choices.text: Praise and pray to the Lord.
Dwell on your doubts.

blocks.why: Praising and praying to the Lord aligns with the teaching that it cleanses the mind of doubt. This relates to the tags 'devotion', 'mind', and 'virtue'.

blocks.question: According to this passage, what cleanses the mind of doubt?
blocks.answer: Praising and praying to the Lord.

blocks.text: Praising and praying to the Lord can help clear doubts and bring peace of mind.
Without the One Lord, there is no other at all. If the soul-bride remains attached to You, then she shall enjoy her Husband Lord.
This passage emphasizes the importance of the One Lord.  Attachment to the Lord allows the soul to enjoy Him. Without the Lord, there is nothing else.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling lost and alone. You can either focus on your separateness, or remember that there is no other than the One Lord.

choices.text: Remember that there is no other than the One Lord.
Focus on your separateness.

blocks.why: Remembering that there is no other than the One Lord aligns with the teaching that He is the only reality. This relates to the tags 'attachment', 'detachment', and 'ego'.

blocks.question: According to this passage, what happens if the soul-bride remains attached to the Lord?
blocks.answer: She shall enjoy her Husband Lord.

blocks.text: Remembering the One Lord can help overcome feelings of loneliness and separation.
When the mind is filthy, everything is filthy; by washing the body, the mind is not cleaned. O my mind, chant the One Name.
This passage highlights the importance of a clean mind.  External cleansing is not enough if the mind is impure.  Chanting the One Name is a way to purify the mind.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling overwhelmed by negative thoughts. You can either focus on external distractions, or chant the One Name.

choices.text: Chant the One Name.
Focus on external distractions.

blocks.why: Chanting the One Name aligns with the teaching that it helps purify the mind. This relates to the tags 'mind', 'maya', and 'detachment'.

blocks.question: According to this passage, what should we chant?

blocks.text: Chanting the One Name can help purify the mind and overcome negative thoughts.
This mind is not controlled by any other discipline, except the Sanctuary of the True Guru. The filth of attachment and possessiveness shall depart, and the mind shall become pure.
The Sanctuary of the True Guru is essential for controlling the mind.  Attachment and possessiveness create impurity.  By meeting the True Guru, the mind can become pure.

blocks.scenario: You are struggling with feelings of attachment and possessiveness. You can either indulge these feelings, or seek the Sanctuary of the True Guru.

choices.text: Seek the Sanctuary of the True Guru.
Indulge these feelings.

blocks.why: Seeking the Sanctuary of the True Guru aligns with the teaching that it helps control the mind and remove attachment. This relates to the tags 'guru', 'shabad', and 'detachment'.

blocks.question: According to this passage, what is essential for controlling the mind?
blocks.answer: The Sanctuary of the True Guru.

blocks.text: Seeking the Sanctuary of the True Guru can help overcome attachment and purify the mind.
By His Grace, service is performed. Think of the True Lord, and you shall obtain peace.
These words speak of the importance of grace in service and devotion. By His grace, our minds become pure. Thinking of the Lord brings peace and freedom from sorrow.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling overwhelmed by daily tasks. Should you:

choices.text: Take a moment to remember the Lord and find peace within.
Continue to rush through tasks, hoping to finish quickly.

blocks.why: Remembering the Lord can bring peace and clarity, helping to manage tasks with a calm mind, aligning with the tags grace and mind.

blocks.question: What brings peace and freedom from sorrow?

blocks.text: Remembering the Lord can bring peace to the mind.
The tongue that does not savor the Lord's essence should be burned. Without the Guru, there is no wisdom, and duality brings suffering.
These words highlight the importance of devotion and the Guru's guidance. Attachment to worldly pleasures and duality leads to pain. The Lord grants His Grace, and meeting the Guru brings blessings.

blocks.scenario: You are choosing how to spend your free time. Should you:

choices.text: Engage in activities that connect you to the Divine.
Indulge in fleeting pleasures that distract you from deeper meaning.

blocks.why: Choosing activities that connect you to the Divine aligns with seeking wisdom and avoiding the suffering of duality, reflecting the tags maya and grace.

blocks.question: What leads to suffering?
blocks.answer: Attachment to worldly pleasures and duality.

blocks.text: Seek the Guru's guidance to avoid the pain of duality.
Under Guru's Instruction, do good deeds and dwell upon the Lord. Acting in ego leads to loss, but meeting the True Guru brings Truth.
These words emphasize the importance of following the Guru's guidance and remembering the Lord. The Lord is the treasure of virtue. Ego leads to loss, while the Guru leads to Truth.

blocks.scenario: You are faced with a difficult decision. Should you:

choices.text: Seek guidance and act with humility.
Rely solely on your own ego and understanding.

blocks.why: Seeking guidance and acting with humility aligns with following the Guru's instruction and avoiding the pitfalls of ego, reflecting the tags guru and ego.

blocks.question: What leads to loss?

blocks.text: Follow the Guru's guidance and remember the Lord.
Hope and desire reside within, but the Lord's Light shines too. Meditate on the Name of the Lord, for the Guru leads to understanding.

These words speak to the duality of human existence, with both worldly desires and divine light present. Meditating on the Lord's Name, guided by the Guru, brings understanding. Gurmukhs are liberated.

blocks.scenario: You notice feelings of desire and restlessness. Should you:

choices.text: Take time to meditate and connect with the Lord.
Give in to every passing desire.

blocks.why: Meditating and connecting with the Lord helps to balance desires and find inner peace, aligning with the tags desire and mind.

blocks.question: Who are liberated?

blocks.text: Meditate on the Lord's Name to find understanding and balance.
Those in the love of duality suffer. Enshrine the Name of the Lord within your heart. The unvirtuous cries out in pain.

These words contrast the suffering of those attached to duality with the peace of those devoted to the Lord. The virtuous constantly chant the Lord's praises. The Lord separates some, while others are drawn to His Name.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling disconnected and unhappy. Should you:

choices.text: Focus on connecting with the Lord through prayer or meditation.
Seek temporary distractions to avoid your feelings.

blocks.why: Connecting with the Lord helps to overcome feelings of disconnection and suffering, aligning with the tags duality and love.

blocks.question: What should you enshrine within your heart?

blocks.text: Focus on the Lord to find peace and avoid suffering.
The Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam is sweet, tasted through the Guru's Shabad. Through the Guru, meditate on the Name of the Lord.
These words describe the joy of experiencing the Lord's Name through the Guru's guidance. Meeting the True Guru is through His Mercy. Love of Maya spreads, but the Guru leads to peace.

blocks.scenario: You are seeking deeper meaning in life. Should you:

choices.text: Seek guidance from a spiritual teacher or mentor.
Focus solely on material success and worldly achievements.

blocks.why: Seeking guidance from a spiritual teacher aligns with the importance of the Guru in understanding the Naam and avoiding the spread of Maya, reflecting the tags guru and maya.

blocks.question: How do you taste the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam?

blocks.text: Seek the Guru's guidance to experience the sweetness of the Naam.
Serving the True Guru brings emancipation. The Gurmukhs have spiritual wisdom and are rid of emotional attachment.
These words highlight the benefits of serving the Guru and attaining spiritual wisdom. The Gurmukh crosses over the world-ocean. The Lord pervades everywhere and cherishes everyone.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling overwhelmed by worldly attachments. Should you:

choices.text: Seek guidance from the Guru and practice detachment.
Cling tightly to your possessions and relationships.

blocks.why: Seeking guidance and practicing detachment helps to overcome worldly attachments and attain spiritual wisdom, aligning with the tags guru and detachment.

blocks.question: What brings emancipation?

This lesson explores the nature of sorrow, self-conceit, and Maya. It highlights the importance of the Saadh Sangat in attaining understanding.

blocks.question: What does not afflict one who does not harbor self-conceit?

This lesson explores the impermanence of the body and the importance of remembering the Divine. It reminds us to meditate on the One.
The body is impermanent and will eventually disperse. Meditate on the One, the Beloved Lord. Forgetting the Lord leads to regret. Remember the Divine who created and adorned you.

Meeting the True Guru brings enlightenment. With the loving support of the Divine, one becomes fearless. The Divine is the Inner-knower and the Creator, and His humble servants are protected.

Act impulsively without considering the consequences.

blocks.why: Embracing contemplation and seeking Divine guidance aligns with 'naam' and cultivates 'fearlessness' by quieting the 'mind'.

blocks.question: What is the world without the Lord's Name?

blocks.text: True contemplation and seeking the Divine can bring fearlessness and clarity to our lives.
The Divine Name is purifying, yet we may not remember it. Entering the Sanctuary of the One, we seek protection.
Thirsty for the Divine vision, we yearn day and night. The Guru opens the door to meet the Divine. Like a fish to water, our minds attach to the Divine, and the Guru quenches our thirst.

blocks.scenario: You feel disconnected from the Divine. Do you:

choices.text: Seek guidance from a Guru and deepen your devotion.
Continue with your daily routine and ignore the feeling.

blocks.why: Seeking guidance from a Guru and deepening devotion aligns with 'naam' and 'devotion', guided by the 'guru'.

blocks.question: Who leads us to meet with the Divine?

blocks.text: Through devotion and the Guru's guidance, we can find the Divine and quench our spiritual thirst.
Surrounded by loving companions, we yearn for the Divine, the treasure of virtue. We dedicate our minds to those who please the Beloved.

The Divine does as He pleases. Eradicating self-conceit helps us find the Beloved. The Guru unites us with the Divine through the Saadh Sangat, fulfilling our hopes and desires. Meeting with the Guru, we find peace.

blocks.scenario: You feel unworthy of Divine love. Do you:

choices.text: Seek guidance from the Guru and join the Saadh Sangat.
Isolate yourself and dwell on your perceived flaws.

blocks.why: Seeking guidance from the Guru and joining the Saadh Sangat fosters 'love' and 'virtue', guided by the 'guru'.

blocks.question: Who unites us with the Divine?

blocks.text: Through the Guru and the Saadh Sangat, we can find Divine love and peace, fulfilling our spiritual desires.
The Divine is lofty, infinite, and indescribable. We seek the Sanctuary of the Divine, who is all-powerful to save us.

We ask to be saved, acknowledging our countless demerits and mistakes. Intoxicated by Maya, we are saved by Divine Grace. Committing sins secretly, we seek mercy to be lifted from the world-ocean. With humility, we pray for a home in the Divine.

blocks.scenario: You feel overwhelmed by your past mistakes. Do you:

choices.text: Seek Divine grace with humility and ask for forgiveness.
Dwell on your mistakes and feel hopeless.

blocks.why: Seeking Divine grace with humility helps overcome 'sin' and fosters 'humility', relying on Divine 'grace'.

blocks.question: What saves us from Maya?

blocks.text: Seeking Divine grace with humility can lift us from our mistakes and provide a home in the Divine.
Meditate on God, our only True Friend. He Himself is pervading everywhere. By meditating, we receive the fruits of our desires.
There is nowhere else to go but to God. We should renounce pride and duality, focusing on the One Lord. Dedicate yourself to God, and you may be absorbed in His True Name.

blocks.scenario: You feel lost and alone. Should you:

choices.text: Remember that God is everywhere and meditate on Him.
Search for a new place or activity to distract yourself.

blocks.why: Remembering God's presence and meditating on Him aligns with the tags of oneness, remembrance, and devotion.

blocks.question: According to this passage, who is our only true friend?

blocks.text: Focusing on God can bring us closer to truth.
Meditating on the Naam brings total peace. Joining the Saadh Sangat helps us merge our light into the Light. The world is a temporary place filled with Maya.

By chanting the Naam, sins are erased and we find satisfaction. The Lord blesses us with mercy and unites us with Himself, burning away the pains of birth and death. Without earning the wealth of the Lord's Name, karma cannot be erased.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling stressed and overwhelmed by worldly desires. Should you:

choices.text: Join a spiritual gathering (Sangat) and meditate on the Naam.
Indulge in material possessions to find temporary relief.

blocks.why: Joining the Saadh Sangat and meditating on the Naam aligns with the tags of naam, sangat, and maya, helping to overcome worldly attachments.

blocks.question: What brings total peace according to this passage?

blocks.text: Finding peace can come from spiritual practice and community.
Without singing the Lord's Name, one wanders through countless incarnations. We receive the consequences of our actions. The world is temporary.
Those who do not remember the Lord wander in doubt and find no rest.  Youth passes, and old age takes over.  By joining the Saadh Sangat and meditating on the Lord, we can be saved.

blocks.scenario: You are worried about the future and past mistakes. Should you:

choices.text: Seek solace in spiritual practice and detachment from worldly worries.
Dwell on past actions and future uncertainties.

blocks.why: Seeking spiritual practice and detachment aligns with the tags of reincarnation, karma, and detachment, helping to find peace.

blocks.question: What happens to those who forget the Lord, according to this passage?

blocks.text: Remembering the Lord can help us find peace.
God is all-pervading, in the beginning, middle, and end. Saints remember the all-pervading Lord. Be absorbed in the Lord's Love.
The Lord is the Destroyer of sins and the Lord of the universe. Implant the True Lord within your mind. Sing the Praise of the One, the Immaculate Lord, who is contained within all.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling disconnected from the world around you. Should you:

choices.text: Remember that God is all-pervading and try to feel His presence everywhere.
Isolate yourself further and focus on your own thoughts.

blocks.why: Remembering God's all-pervading presence aligns with the tags of oneness, remembrance, and love, helping to feel connected.

blocks.question: According to this passage, what should we be absorbed in?

blocks.text: Remembering God's presence can help us feel connected.
The Lord creates us and places us in the womb. We should meditate on the Lord with every breath. Through His Name, we are saved.
Even in the womb, we remember the Lord.  We should not forget the Master, as His Name saves us.  He protects and preserves us; do not forget Him.

blocks.scenario: You are facing a difficult situation and feel afraid. Should you:

choices.text: Remember the Lord and seek His grace.
Give in to fear and despair.

blocks.why: Remembering the Lord and seeking His grace aligns with the tags of remembrance, grace, and fear, helping to overcome fear.

blocks.question: According to this passage, what saves us?

blocks.text: Remembering the Lord can help us overcome fear.
God grants our desires and destroys suffering. Love Him, with whom you enjoy all pleasures. He gave you your soul.
Remember God in meditation, as He is not far away. He fashioned this beautiful body. God is the all-powerful Great Giver, and meditating on Him rejuvenates the body and mind.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling ungrateful for what you have. Should you:

choices.text: Remember all that God has given you and express gratitude.
Focus on what you lack and feel discontent.

blocks.why: Remembering God's gifts and expressing gratitude aligns with the tags of devotion, compassion, and gratitude, helping to cultivate thankfulness.

blocks.question: According to this passage, what destroys pain and suffering?

blocks.text: Gratitude can help us appreciate what we have.
Without loving devotional worship, one forgets God and becomes like a ghost. Love for anything other than the Lord will break. The ungrateful wander in reincarnation.
Working hard for family and Maya leads to forgetting God.  True life inspires love of the Lord.  Forgetting Him leads to the body turning to dust.

blocks.scenario: You are overly attached to material possessions and family. Should you:

choices.text: Cultivate detachment and focus on loving the Lord.
Continue to prioritize material possessions and family above all else.

blocks.why: Cultivating detachment and focusing on loving the Lord aligns with the tags of maya, detachment, and reincarnation, helping to avoid attachment to worldly things.

blocks.question: According to this passage, what happens to those who forget God?

blocks.text: Detachment can help us focus on what truly matters.
Chanting the Name of the Lord washes away all sins. When the True Lord abides in one's mind, all sins are dispelled. Bless me with Your mercy.
Chanting the Name of the Lord is more valuable than countless acts of charity. Meditating on the Lord's Name erases millions of sins. If pre-ordained, one is absorbed in the Lord's lotus feet.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling burdened by past mistakes and sins. Should you:

choices.text: Chant the Name of the Lord and seek His mercy.
Dwell on your past mistakes and feel hopeless.

blocks.why: Chanting the Name of the Lord and seeking His mercy aligns with the tags of naam, seva, and kirpa, helping to overcome past sins.

blocks.question: According to this passage, what washes away all sins?
blocks.answer: Chanting the Name of the Lord

blocks.text: Chanting the Name can help us find peace.
These verses discuss attachment to worldly pleasures and forgetting the Lord. Those engrossed in possessions and desires, but without remembrance, are likened to maggots.

The verses highlight that focusing solely on material comforts and pleasures, without remembering God, is ultimately meaningless.  Even enjoying luxuries, without devotion, leads to a state of unrest and dissatisfaction.  True peace comes from remembering the Lord.

blocks.scenario: You've been working hard and finally have the money to buy a new car. You spend hours researching features and imagining driving it.  However, you haven't spent time in prayer or reflection lately.

choices.text: Take a moment to be thankful for your blessings and remember the source of your abilities.
Focus solely on the excitement of the new car and ignore your spiritual practice.

blocks.why: Choosing A aligns with the lesson's emphasis on remembering the Lord amidst worldly pleasures, connecting to the tags of maya, attachment, and remembrance.

blocks.question: According to the verses, what is the key to finding true peace?

blocks.text: Remembering the Lord can bring peace, even amidst worldly comforts.
These verses describe the importance of devotion and seeking the Lord.  They emphasize renouncing illusion and finding solace in the company of the holy.

The verses suggest that true fulfillment comes from loving the Lord and seeking Him in all directions.  Joining the Saadh Sangat and chanting His Name are ways to overcome the illusion of Maya.  Even in humble circumstances, one can be a king by being imbued with the Lord's Name.

blocks.scenario: You feel lost and disconnected. You see a flyer for a local gathering focused on spiritual growth and community. You are hesitant because you don't know anyone there.

choices.text: Attend the gathering with an open mind, hoping to connect with others seeking spiritual growth.
Stay home, feeling more comfortable in your solitude.

blocks.why: Choosing A reflects the lesson's emphasis on finding solace and growth in the Saadh Sangat, aligning with the tags of devotion, sangat, and naam.

blocks.question: According to the verses, where can one find solace from the illusion of Maya?
blocks.answer: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

blocks.text: Seeking the Lord and connecting with others can bring true fulfillment.

These verses describe Maya as a dream, highlighting the fleeting nature of worldly pleasures.  Emotional attachment to these illusions is described as sweet but ultimately fake without the Lord's Name.

The verses suggest that attaching oneself to worldly pleasures is like being engrossed in a dream.  Upon awakening, the pleasures vanish, leaving sadness.  True and lasting fulfillment comes from the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

blocks.scenario: You are captivated by a new hobby, spending all your free time and energy on it. You start neglecting other important aspects of your life, like family and spiritual practice.

choices.text: Recognize the potential for imbalance and re-prioritize your time to include family, spiritual practice, and other responsibilities.
Continue to focus solely on the hobby, enjoying the immediate gratification it provides.

blocks.why: Choosing A aligns with the lesson's message of detaching from fleeting pleasures and remembering the Lord, connecting to the tags of maya, attachment, and naam.

blocks.question: According to the verses, what is Maya compared to?

blocks.text: Remembering the Lord's Name can help us see through the illusion of Maya.
These verses describe the emptiness of worldly achievements without the Lord's Name.  They highlight the dangers of ego, desire, and anger, and the importance of the Guru's guidance.

The verses suggest that even conquering the world is meaningless if the Lord is forgotten.  Living with ego and desire leads to regret.  The Guru's guidance is essential to avoid wandering like Satan.

blocks.scenario: You are offered a promotion at work that comes with more power and prestige. However, it also requires you to be more competitive and demanding.

choices.text: Consider whether the promotion aligns with your values and seek guidance from a trusted mentor or spiritual leader.
Accept the promotion without hesitation, focusing solely on the increased power and prestige.

blocks.why: Choosing A reflects the lesson's emphasis on seeking guidance and avoiding ego and desire, connecting to the tags of ego, desire, and guru.

blocks.question: According to the verses, what is essential to avoid wandering like Satan?
blocks.answer: The guidance of the Perfect, Divine Guru.

blocks.text: Seeking guidance and avoiding ego can lead to a more fulfilling life.
These verses describe the fraudulent nature of power, beauty, and wealth. They emphasize that nothing goes with us in the end except the Lord.
The verses suggest that worldly possessions and pride are ultimately meaningless.  Attaching oneself to these things leads to dissatisfaction and fear.  True peace comes from remembering the Lord.

blocks.scenario: You are worried about losing your job and the financial security it provides. You find yourself constantly anxious and preoccupied with worst-case scenarios.

choices.text: Focus on the present moment, trust in the Lord's plan, and remember that true security comes from within.
Dwell on your fears and anxieties, allowing them to consume your thoughts and energy.

blocks.why: Choosing A aligns with the lesson's message of detachment and trust in the Lord, connecting to the tags of maya, detachment, and fear.

blocks.question: According to the verses, what is fraudulent?

blocks.text: Trusting in the Lord can dispel fear and bring inner peace.
These verses describe the sweetness of the Saadh Sangat and the Blessed Vision of God. They emphasize the love that drenches the soul and the piercing power of Truth.

The verses suggest that true sweetness is found not in worldly pleasures, but in the company of the holy and the love of God.  The Truth pierces through illusion, and the Master seems sweet to those who are devoted.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling disconnected from your spiritual practice and unsure of your path. You have the opportunity to spend time with a group of people who are deeply devoted and committed to their faith.

choices.text: Spend time with the devoted group, hoping to be inspired and reconnect with your own faith.
Avoid the group, feeling uncomfortable with their level of devotion.

blocks.why: Choosing A reflects the lesson's emphasis on the sweetness of the Saadh Sangat and the power of love and truth, connecting to the tags of love, sangat, and truth.

blocks.question: According to the verses, what is sweeter than princely pleasures?
blocks.answer: The Saadh Sangat and the Blessed Vision of God.

blocks.text: Connecting with others and seeking the Truth can bring true sweetness to life.
These verses use analogies of a fish needing water, a rainbird needing raindrops, and a deer being enticed, to describe the Saints' devotion to the Lord's lotus feet. They desire nothing else.
The verses suggest that the Saints' love for the Lord is as essential as water for a fish.  They crave His presence and desire nothing else.  Seeing His face brings ultimate satisfaction.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling drawn to spend more time in prayer and meditation, but you also have many other desires and distractions pulling you in different directions.

choices.text: Prioritize your spiritual practice and dedicate time to connect with the Lord, even amidst other desires.
Allow yourself to be consumed by other desires and distractions, neglecting your spiritual practice.

blocks.why: Choosing A reflects the lesson's emphasis on prioritizing devotion and love for the Lord above all else, connecting to the tags of devotion, desire, and love.

blocks.question: According to the verses, what do the Saints desire?

blocks.text: Prioritizing devotion can bring true fulfillment and satisfaction.
These verses describe the importance of contemplating the Lord's lotus feet and remembering His Name.  They emphasize that the Lord fulfills our hopes and is always present.

The verses suggest that true fulfillment comes from remembering the Lord and having Him woven into the fabric of our minds.  Our hopes rest in Him, and He is always watching over us.  By remembering Him, we can overcome grief and worry.

blocks.scenario: You are facing a difficult challenge and feeling overwhelmed with worry and uncertainty about the future.

choices.text: Turn to prayer and meditation, remembering the Lord's presence and trusting that He will guide you through the challenge.
Dwell on your worries and anxieties, allowing them to consume your thoughts and energy.

blocks.why: Choosing A reflects the lesson's emphasis on remembrance, devotion, and hope in the Lord, connecting to the tags of remembrance, devotion, and hope.

blocks.question: According to the verses, where do our hopes rest?

blocks.text: Remembering the Lord can bring hope and dispel worry in challenging times.
Chanting the Lord's Name and listening to His Shabad is valuable. Those who meditate on the Supreme Lord are blessed. Being in the Society of the Saints is also valuable.

Our concerns are temporary, except for the One Lord. Those who love their True Lord are blessed. Actions like listening to sermons, bowing before God, writing praises, and walking on God's path are meaningful.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling overwhelmed by daily worries. Should you:

choices.text: Take a moment to listen to a sermon or chant the Lord's name.
Continue to focus on your worries and try to solve them immediately.

blocks.why: Listening to sermons and chanting the Lord's name can help shift focus from worries, aligning with the tags of naam and devotion.

blocks.question: According to this lesson, what makes hands beautiful?
blocks.answer: Those hands which write the Praises of the infinite Lord.

blocks.text: Remember to find value in devotion and the Society of the Saints.
Chanting the Lord's Name can activate one's destiny. Seeing the Lord brings peace. The Society of the Saints is a great fortune.
The moment we meet with the Beloved Lord is approved. Meditating on the Lord fulfills desires. The mind thirsts for the Blessed Vision of the Lord.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling restless and searching for peace. Should you:

choices.text: Try to find the Society of the Saints or meditate on the Lord.
Look for distractions to keep your mind occupied.

blocks.why: Seeking the Society of the Saints or meditating aligns with the tags of naam and peace.

blocks.question: What is fulfilled by meditating on the Lord?

blocks.text: Seek peace through chanting the Lord's name and connecting with the Divine.
The Lord is the Purifier and dispels distress. Taking His Protective Sanctuary is helpful. Renouncing self-conceit and holding tight to the Lord's Feet is valuable.
Sorrows and troubles depart when beholding God. The Lord loves devotees and saves sinners. Without the Lord, there is no other support.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling lost and need guidance. Should you:

choices.text: Offer a prayer and seek the Lord's grace.
Rely solely on your own understanding and abilities.

blocks.why: Seeking the Lord's grace aligns with the tags of grace and humility.

blocks.question: What departs when beholding God?

blocks.text: Find strength and fearlessness by seeking the Lord's grace and support.
Singing the Lord's Praises is a support. Associating with the Saints brings purity. Chanting the Name of the Lord brings coolness.
All beings are saved through the Lord's protection. Hearing the Glory of the Lord makes the mind fearless. The Society of the Saints is obtained through good deeds.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling anxious and fearful. Should you:

choices.text: Listen to the Lord's Praises or seek the Society of the Saints.
Avoid your feelings and try to distract yourself.

blocks.why: Listening to the Lord's Praises and seeking the Society of the Saints aligns with the tags of naam and fearlessness.

blocks.question: What makes the mind fearless?
blocks.answer: Hearing of the Glory of the Lord of the Universe.

blocks.text: Find fearlessness and peace by connecting with the Lord and His community.
Singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Name dispels pains. Kindness from the Lord removes engrossment in Maya. Meditating on God brings salvation.
When God is merciful, Maya does not cling. Meditating on the Naam eliminates sins. The body becomes pure by bathing in the dust of the feet of the Lord's servants.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling attached to material possessions and worldly desires. Should you:

choices.text: Meditate on the Naam and seek the Lord's grace.
Focus on acquiring more possessions to feel secure.

blocks.why: Meditating on the Naam and seeking the Lord's grace helps detach from Maya, aligning with the tags of grace and naam.

blocks.question: What is eliminated by meditating on the Naam?

blocks.text: Seek freedom from Maya by meditating on the Naam and connecting with the Divine.
The Guru is the Lord, compassionate, and the saving grace. The Guru is the boat to cross the world-ocean. Associating with the Guru helps one meditate on the Lord.
When the Guru is merciful, demerits are dispelled. The Guru uplifts the lowly. Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord is valuable.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling lost and need guidance. Should you:

choices.text: Seek the guidance of the Guru and meditate on the Lord.
Rely solely on your own understanding and abilities.

blocks.why: Seeking the Guru's guidance and meditating aligns with the tags of guru and grace.

blocks.question: What happens when the Guru becomes merciful?

blocks.text: Find guidance and compassion by connecting with the Guru and meditating on the Lord.
Seeing and hearing only the One Lord is valuable. Begging for the gift of the Naam is important. Serving and contemplating the One Lord is helpful.
God is merciful and all-pervading. He Himself grants and receives gifts. Coming and going are by His Will. Nanak begs for the gift of the Name.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling disconnected and separate from others. Should you:

choices.text: Contemplate the One Lord and seek the gift of the Naam.
Focus on your differences and maintain your distance.

blocks.why: Contemplating the One Lord promotes a sense of oneness, aligning with the tags of oneness and naam.

blocks.question: What is steady and unchanging?
blocks.answer: Your place is steady and unchanging.

blocks.text: Find unity and connection by recognizing the One Lord in all things.
The mind can be in Maya's hands. The Lord is the Guru of the World. The five vices can corrupt the mind.
We are called lustful beings of the Dark Age. The five vices lead us away from the Lord moment by moment.

blocks.scenario: You are struggling with negative thoughts and desires. Should you:

choices.text: Seek guidance from the Guru and try to control your mind.
Give in to your desires and let your mind wander.

blocks.why: Seeking guidance and controlling the mind helps to overcome Maya and desire.

blocks.question: What has corrupted my mind?

blocks.text: Be mindful of your thoughts and desires, and seek guidance to stay on the right path.
This passage speaks of seeing "loads of pain and suffering" and feeling a lack of faith. It mentions being fooled and destroyed, yet still not tiring of these illusions.

The verses express a sense of being overwhelmed by suffering and a lack of faith, even in the face of evidence. There's a feeling of being trapped and manipulated by illusions, yet still drawn to them. The speaker feels shameless for not being tired of these illusions.

blocks.scenario: You feel overwhelmed by negative news and social media. You know it's making you feel bad, but you keep scrolling.

choices.text: Recognize the cycle and choose to step away from the news and social media.
Continue scrolling, hoping to find something positive eventually.

blocks.why: This relates to the tags because recognizing the cycle of suffering and illusion (maya) is the first step to breaking free from doubt and finding peace.

blocks.question: What is the main feeling expressed in this passage?
blocks.answer: Being overwhelmed by suffering and a lack of faith.

blocks.text: It's important to recognize when we are caught in cycles of suffering and illusion.
This passage expresses a deep yearning for the Lord and the importance of the Guru. It speaks of finding sanctuary in the Lord's protection and escaping the cycle of reincarnation.

The verses convey a sense of desperation without the Lord and a longing for union. The Guru is seen as the means to connect with the Lord and break free from the cycle of birth and death. The heart yearns for the Lord, and the eyes seek Him.

blocks.scenario: You feel lost and disconnected from your purpose. You are considering different paths to find meaning.

choices.text: Seek guidance from a trusted mentor or spiritual teacher.
Continue searching on your own, hoping to stumble upon the right path.

blocks.why: This relates to the tags because seeking guidance (Guru) can help foster devotion and potentially lead to liberation from the cycle of reincarnation.

blocks.question: According to this passage, what is the role of the Guru?
blocks.answer: To unite us with the Lord and break free from reincarnation.

blocks.text: Seeking guidance and cultivating devotion can help us find meaning and purpose.
This passage contrasts those attached to greed with those who find the Naam through the Guru. It highlights the importance of spiritual wisdom and a discriminating intellect.

The verses emphasize that attachment to greed leads to forgetting the Lord. Those who are self-willed and ignorant are seen as unfortunate. The True Guru provides spiritual wisdom and the Naam, which is seen as a blessing.

blocks.scenario: You are faced with a decision: pursuing a job with a high salary but questionable ethics, or a job with lower pay but aligned with your values.

choices.text: Choose the job aligned with your values, even if it means less money.
Choose the higher-paying job, prioritizing financial security.

blocks.why: This relates to the tags because choosing values over greed aligns with the concept of Gurmukh and seeking the Naam, leading to spiritual wisdom.

blocks.question: What happens when the mind is attached to greed?

blocks.text: Spiritual wisdom and detachment from greed are important for remembering the Lord.
This passage describes the state of Saints who are always in the Lord's love and fearless. It contrasts this with the suffering that comes from forgetting the Lord.

The verses suggest that those who are devoted to the Lord experience freedom from disease, sorrow, and fear. They are absorbed in His love and have surrendered their minds to Him. Forgetting the Lord leads to ruin, while remembering Him provides support and protection.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling anxious about an upcoming presentation at work.

choices.text: Focus on your preparation and trust in your abilities, remembering the support you have.
Dwell on your fears and imagine all the things that could go wrong.

blocks.why: This relates to the tags because trusting in your abilities and remembering support aligns with the idea of fearlessness and being in the Lord's love, contrasting with the ruin that comes from forgetting.

blocks.question: What is the result of surrendering one's mind to the Lord?

blocks.text: Remembering the Lord and surrendering to love can bring fearlessness and peace.
This passage describes the wandering mind, intoxicated by Maya, and the importance of the Saadh Sangat. It speaks of the Lord's grace and the blessedness of those who sing His praises.

The verses depict the mind as easily distracted and enticed by worldly pleasures. Without focusing on the Lord's teachings or the company of the holy, the mind remains deluded. Only through the Lord's grace can one sing His praises and find peace.

blocks.scenario: You have a free evening. You could spend it attending a community event or scrolling through social media.

choices.text: Attend the community event, seeking connection and positive interaction.
Stay home and scroll through social media, seeking entertainment and distraction.

blocks.why: This relates to the tags because choosing the community event aligns with the concept of Saadh Sangat, contrasting with the intoxication of Maya.

blocks.question: What is the mind intoxicated by?
blocks.answer: Maya and the taste of greed.

blocks.text: Seeking the company of the holy and focusing on the Lord can help overcome the distractions of Maya.
This passage describes someone who does not practice the Naam, charity, or good deeds. It emphasizes the importance of the Saadh Sangat and the Lord's love for His devotees.

The verses depict a person entangled in falsehoods and the company of negative influences. They neglect service, meditation, and good deeds. Seeking the Saadh Sangat and recognizing the Lord's love are presented as a path to redemption.

blocks.scenario: You have an opportunity to volunteer your time to help others in need.

choices.text: Volunteer your time and effort to help those in need.
Decline the opportunity, prioritizing your own personal interests.

blocks.why: This relates to the tags because volunteering aligns with the concept of Seva and contrasts with neglecting good deeds, ultimately leading to the Naam through Sangat.

blocks.question: What is neglected in this passage?
blocks.answer: The Naam, charity, good deeds, and service to the True Guru.

blocks.text: Practicing the Naam, charity, and service can help us connect with the Lord and find purpose.
This passage speaks of the futility of worldly possessions and decorations without understanding or the Lord's presence. It contrasts attachment to Maya with the joy of union with the Lord.

The verses suggest that accumulating wealth and adorning oneself are meaningless without spiritual understanding. The soul-bride finds pain in decorations without her Husband Lord. Working tirelessly for worldly gain without purpose is ultimately useless.

blocks.scenario: You are tempted to buy a new item you don't really need, but it's on sale and everyone seems to have it.

choices.text: Reflect on whether you truly need the item and avoid impulse buying.
Buy the item, hoping it will bring you happiness and satisfaction.

blocks.why: This relates to the tags because reflecting on your needs and avoiding impulse buying aligns with detachment from Maya and attachment to understanding.

blocks.question: What is the result of putting on decorations without the Lord?

blocks.text: True fulfillment comes from spiritual understanding and detachment from worldly possessions.
This passage speaks of the Lord's grace in implanting the Naam within the heart. It emphasizes the importance of love for God and acceptance of His will.

The verses suggest that through God's mercy, the Naam is awakened within us. This leads to a deep love for God and acceptance of His will. Even sinners can be purified through singing the Lord's praises.

blocks.scenario: You experience a setback in your personal or professional life.

choices.text: Accept the situation as part of God's will and seek to learn from it.
Become angry and resentful, blaming others for your misfortune.

blocks.why: This relates to the tags because accepting the situation as part of God's will aligns with the concept of love and grace, contrasting with resentment and blame.

blocks.question: What is implanted in the heart through God's mercy?

blocks.text: Embracing God's grace, cultivating love, and accepting His will can bring peace and understanding.
Consider yourself the dust of all. In the Company of the Holy, you can obtain God. Always remember that you are God's child and ask for the gift of the Name.

This passage emphasizes humility and the importance of seeking the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. It also highlights a personal connection with God, like a child to a parent, and the desire for the gift of the Divine Name. The Name is like nourishment.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling proud after receiving praise for a project. You remember this teaching.

choices.text: Acknowledge the praise, but remember to stay humble and grateful.
Let the praise inflate your ego and feel superior to others.

blocks.why: Choosing A aligns with the tags of humility and devotion, reminding us to remain grounded even in moments of success.

blocks.question: According to this passage, what can be obtained in the Company of the Holy?

blocks.text: Strive for humility and seek the company of the holy to draw closer to God.
