True worship is that which pleases the Divine Will. The body is limited, and the Divine is the only true hope and support. By Divine Grace, one is placed on the path, and the Divine Name is the saving grace.

blocks.scenario: You are facing a difficult decision and feel unsure of what to do. You could either: A) Pray for guidance and trust in the Divine Will, or B) Rely solely on your own understanding and ignore any spiritual guidance.

choices.text: Pray for guidance and trust in the Divine Will
Rely solely on your own understanding

blocks.why: Choosing A aligns with the lesson's emphasis on pleasing the Lord's Will and seeking support from the Divine, reflecting the tags.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, where does the Divine abide?

blocks.text: Aligning with the Divine Will and seeking support from the Divine can bring peace and clarity.

This lesson highlights the importance of serving the holy, meditating on the Divine, and detaching from worldly attachments. It speaks of the purifying power of the dust of the feet of the saints. Only the Name of God will call to you in the end.

Serving the holy and longing for the dust of their feet purifies and sanctifies. Meditating on the Divine with every breath is essential. Abandoning love for everything else and honoring the Formless Lord is key.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling overwhelmed by material possessions and desires. You could either: A) Donate some of your belongings and focus on spiritual practices, or B) Continue accumulating possessions, hoping they will bring lasting happiness.

choices.text: Donate belongings, focus on spiritual practices
Continue accumulating possessions

blocks.why: Choosing A reflects the lesson's emphasis on detachment and abandoning the love of everything else, aligning with the tags.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, what purifies and sanctifies?
blocks.answer: The dust of the feet of the saints

blocks.text: True fulfillment comes from serving the holy, meditating on the Divine, and detaching from worldly attachments.

This lesson speaks of longing for the Divine and the importance of humility. It emphasizes that the Divine is merciful and that renouncing pride and attachment leads to meeting the Dear Lord. The Lord imbues all with the Color of His Love.
The heart yearns for the Divine, and humble saints are absorbed in Him. By dedicating your heart and renouncing pride and attachment, you can meet the Divine. The Lord's love permeates all beings.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling proud of your accomplishments. You could either: A) Acknowledge your blessings and express gratitude to the Divine, or B) Take full credit for your success and boast about it to others.

choices.text: Acknowledge blessings, express gratitude
Take full credit, boast to others

blocks.why: Choosing A aligns with the lesson's emphasis on humility and recognizing the Divine's role in your life, reflecting the tags.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, what leads to meeting the Dear Lord?

blocks.text: Humility and recognizing the Divine's presence can lead to a deeper connection.

This lesson contrasts ritualistic practices with the importance of joining the True Congregation and having a good Guru. It speaks of the disease of egotism and the fires of desire. Liberation comes through a good Guru.

Performing rituals without joining the Sat Sangat is insufficient. Egotism and desires cause suffering. Liberation is attained through the grace of a good Guru, and meeting with the Holy quenches thirst.

blocks.scenario: You are invited to a gathering that emphasizes rigid adherence to rituals. You could either: A) Seek out a gathering focused on genuine spiritual connection and guidance, or B) Attend the ritualistic gathering, hoping it will bring you closer to the Divine.

choices.text: Seek a gathering focused on genuine connection
Attend the ritualistic gathering

blocks.why: Choosing A aligns with the lesson's emphasis on the Sat Sangat and the importance of a good Guru, reflecting the tags.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, what is needed for liberation?

blocks.text: True spiritual growth comes from genuine connection and guidance, not just rituals.

This lesson explores the idea of surrendering to the Divine Will and the importance of humility. It speaks of falling at the feet of the Saints and meditating with love. Meeting the Divine is pleasing to His Will.
One can offer their heart as a sacrifice to the Divine. Meditating with love and falling at the feet of the Saints is important. Meeting the Divine is only possible by pleasing His Will.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling frustrated because things are not going according to your plan. You could either: A) Accept the situation and trust that everything is happening according to the Divine Will, or B) Become angry and try to force things to go your way.

choices.text: Accept the situation, trust the Divine Will
Become angry, force things your way

blocks.why: Choosing A aligns with the lesson's emphasis on pleasing the Divine Will and surrendering to His plan, reflecting the tags.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, how does one meet the Divine?

blocks.text: Surrendering to the Divine Will and practicing humility can bring peace and acceptance.

This lesson emphasizes the importance of the Divine Name, compassion, and detachment. It speaks of experiencing spiritual wisdom through the Saints and singing praises to the Divine. Abandoning attachment and pride is key.

Through the Saints, one can experience spiritual wisdom. Singing praises to the Divine and being attuned to His feet is essential. Seeking kindness and compassion and abandoning attachment and pride are important steps.

blocks.scenario: You are holding onto a grudge against someone who wronged you. You could either: A) Forgive the person and let go of the resentment, or B) Continue to harbor the grudge and seek revenge.

choices.text: Forgive the person, let go of resentment
Harbor the grudge, seek revenge

blocks.why: Choosing A aligns with the lesson's emphasis on compassion and abandoning attachment, reflecting the tags.

blocks.question: According to the lesson, what should be abandoned?
blocks.answer: Emotional attachment, doubt, and egotistical pride

blocks.text: Cultivating compassion, seeking the Divine Name, and practicing detachment can lead to inner peace.
This pauri tells us that rituals and efforts alone do not bring us closer to the Divine. Instead, peace comes from vibrating and meditating on the Name.

External acts like pilgrimages or austerities are not enough. True peace is found within, through focusing on the Divine Name. The Divine is described as the purifier of sinners and destroyer of fear.

blocks.scenario: You feel anxious about an upcoming presentation. You could either:

choices.text: Spend time in quiet reflection, focusing on the Divine Name.
Obsessively rehearse every detail, hoping to eliminate all possible errors.

blocks.why: Choosing A aligns with the pauri's message that peace comes from meditating on the Name, addressing the anxiety at its root. This relates to the tags 'naam' and 'peace'.

blocks.question: According to this pauri, what brings true peace?

blocks.text: True peace comes from within, through meditating on the Divine Name.
This pauri speaks of finding satisfaction and salvation through devotion. It emphasizes seeking refuge in the Divine and recognizing the Divine's nature to purify sinners.

The eyes and ears find contentment in seeing the Divine and hearing praise. The Divine is the support for the unsupported, and those who meditate are saved. The inherent nature of the Divine is to purify sinners.

blocks.scenario: You made a mistake at work. You can either:

choices.text: Reflect on what happened, ask for forgiveness, and focus on learning from the experience.
Ignore it and hope no one notices.

blocks.why: Choosing A reflects the pauri's message of seeking refuge and forgiveness, aligning with the tags 'devotion', 'grace', and 'forgiveness'.

blocks.question: What is the inherent nature of the Divine, according to this pauri?

blocks.text: Seek refuge in the Divine, knowing that the Divine's nature is to purify and forgive.

This pauri describes the world as a place of wickedness and attachment. It speaks of the Divine's grace in lifting us out of this swamp and emphasizes singing praises to the Kind and Compassionate Lord.
The world is full of wickedness, and people are attached to pride. The Divine rescues us and is the master of the masterless. The mind thirsts for the Divine, who is the treasure of virtue.

blocks.scenario: You see someone struggling with a heavy bag. You could either:

choices.text: Offer to help them carry it.
Continue walking, minding your own business.

blocks.why: Choosing A reflects the pauri's message of compassion and virtue, aligning with the tags 'attachment', 'compassion', and 'virtue'.

blocks.question: What is the world described as in this pauri?
blocks.answer: A swamp of wickedness and corruption.

blocks.text: Strive to act with compassion and sing praises to the Kind and Compassionate Lord.
This pauri teaches us to give up ego and find contentment in the Naam. It suggests that material possessions are useless without the Divine's presence.
Material comforts are meaningless without the Naam. Even simple living can be peaceful with the Divine. We are encouraged to give up ego and call out to the Divine.

blocks.scenario: You are offered a promotion that comes with a higher salary but also more stress. You could either:

choices.text: Consider if the added stress will take away from your inner peace, and prioritize contentment.
Accept the promotion without hesitation, focusing on the financial benefits.

blocks.why: Choosing A reflects the pauri's message of finding contentment over material possessions, aligning with the tags 'ego', 'naam', and 'contentment'.

blocks.question: According to this pauri, what are material possessions without the Naam?

blocks.text: Give up ego and seek contentment in the Naam, understanding that material possessions are not the key to happiness.
This pauri encourages us to break free from attachments and silence the turmoil of egotism. It emphasizes chanting and meditating on the Divine.

We should break free from the bonds of the 'five thieves' (likely referring to negative emotions or desires). The turmoil of egotism should be silenced. Chanting and meditating on the Divine is important.

blocks.scenario: You find yourself constantly comparing yourself to others on social media. You could either:

choices.text: Limit your time on social media and focus on your own inner peace and growth.
Continue scrolling, trying to keep up with the latest trends.

blocks.why: Choosing A reflects the pauri's message of breaking free from attachments and silencing egotism, aligning with the tags 'maya', 'ego', and 'mind'.

blocks.question: What should be silenced, according to this pauri?

blocks.text: Break free from attachments, silence egotism, and chant and meditate on the Divine.
This pauri speaks of being saved through chanting the Naam and the grace of the Saints. It highlights the dispelling of emotional attachment, fear, and doubt.

Chanting the Naam leads to salvation through Divine grace. Emotional attachment, fear, and doubt are dispelled by the grace of the Saints. The speaker has wandered through lifetimes and now seeks refuge at the Divine's door.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling overwhelmed by doubts and fears about the future. You could either:

choices.text: Seek guidance from a trusted mentor or spiritual community and focus on chanting the Naam.
Isolate yourself and dwell on your worries.

blocks.why: Choosing A reflects the pauri's message of dispelling fear and doubt through the grace of the Saints and chanting the Naam, aligning with the tags 'grace', 'doubt', and 'fear'.

blocks.question: What is dispelled by the grace of the Saints, according to this pauri?

blocks.text: Seek guidance and chant the Naam to dispel fear and doubt, finding solace in Divine grace.
This pauri describes the kindness of the Divine and the support of the Naam. It speaks of meeting the Divine through innocent faith and joining the Saadh Sangat (holy congregation).
The Divine has been kind and blessed the speaker with the support of the Naam. Meeting the Divine through innocent faith brings peace. Joining the Saadh Sangat is a blessing.

blocks.scenario: You are invited to a gathering of people who share your spiritual beliefs. You could either:

choices.text: Attend the gathering with an open heart, seeking connection and shared understanding.
Decline the invitation, preferring to keep your spiritual practice private.

blocks.why: Choosing A reflects the pauri's message of joining the Saadh Sangat, aligning with the tags 'naam', 'faith', and 'sangat'.

blocks.question: How does one meet God, according to this pauri?

blocks.text: Embrace innocent faith and seek the company of the holy to find support and connection.
This pauri speaks of falling in love with the Divine's Feet and abandoning everything else. It emphasizes the all-pervading nature of the Divine.
The speaker has fallen in love with the Divine and abandoned all other attachments. The Divine is present everywhere. Clever tricks are useless; only love and devotion matter.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling overwhelmed by material desires. You could either:

choices.text: Focus on cultivating love and devotion for the Divine, letting go of excessive desires.
Indulge in your desires, seeking temporary satisfaction.

blocks.why: Choosing A reflects the pauri's message of abandoning other attachments and focusing on love for the Divine, aligning with the tags 'love', 'oneness', and 'detachment'.

blocks.question: What is the speaker in love with, according to this pauri?

blocks.text: Cultivate love and devotion for the Divine, letting go of other attachments and recognizing the Divine's all-pervading presence.
The Lord is only met when He shows His Mercy. Remember His Lotus Feet with every breath, night and day.
We may try many things, but meeting the Lord depends on His Mercy. God is Kind and Compassionate, a Treasure of Mercy. Remembering Him constantly brings us closer.

blocks.scenario: You've been working hard on a project, but it's not going as planned. Do you:

choices.text: Remember God and ask for His Mercy and guidance.
Keep trying harder on your own, relying only on your own efforts.

blocks.why: Remembering God and asking for His Mercy aligns with the tags of kirpa, devotion, and remembrance.

blocks.question: According to this passage, how do we meet the Lord?

blocks.text: Remembering God and seeking His Mercy can guide us.
The Lord is seen deep within the heart. In the Sanctuary of the Saints, terrible pain is taken away.
The Lord is present everywhere and can be found within. Being in the company of saints can remove suffering. God's humble servants are in love with Him.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling overwhelmed by a difficult situation. Do you:

choices.text: Seek the company of spiritually-minded people for support and guidance.
Isolate yourself and try to deal with the problem alone.

blocks.why: Seeking the company of spiritually-minded people connects to the tags of sangat, love, and peace.

blocks.question: Where can the Lord be seen?

blocks.text: Finding support and love can help ease our pain.
The Fear of God and loving devotion leads to exaltation. Egotistical people wander endlessly.
Devotion and reverence bring us closer to God. Those who are self-centered and attached to ego wander without purpose. They are foolish and always followed by death.

blocks.scenario: You receive praise for an accomplishment. Do you:

choices.text: Acknowledge the praise but remain humble and focused on God.
Let the praise inflate your ego and feel superior to others.

blocks.why: Remaining humble and focused on God aligns with the tags of hukam, haumai, and detachment.

blocks.question: What leads to exaltation?
blocks.answer: Fear of God and loving devotion.

blocks.text: Humility and devotion can guide us away from ego.
Give up your pride and chant the Name of the Lord to find peace. Without meditating on Him, life is uselessly wasting away.
Releasing ego and meditating on the Divine Name brings peace. The more we meditate, the more peace we find. Without this meditation, life is wasted.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling stressed and anxious. Do you:

choices.text: Take some time to meditate and chant the Name of the Lord.
Distract yourself with entertainment or other activities.

blocks.why: Meditating and chanting the Name aligns with the tags of naam, peace, and detachment.

blocks.question: What should we give up to find peace?

blocks.text: Chanting the Name can bring us peace.
Following the Guru's Teachings, the Lord seems sweet. Through the Word of the True Guru's Bani, focus your consciousness.
When we follow the Guru's teachings, we find the Lord pleasing. The Guru's Bani reveals the Primal Lord, so we should focus our minds on it. The mind is softened and absorbed in the Naam.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling lost and confused. Do you:

choices.text: Seek guidance from the Guru's teachings and focus your mind on the Divine Word.
Rely solely on your own understanding and ignore spiritual guidance.

blocks.why: Seeking guidance from the Guru and focusing on the Divine Word aligns with the tags of shabad, naam, and guru.

blocks.question: What makes the Lord seem sweet?

blocks.text: The Guru's teachings can guide us to the Divine.
Without the Naam, we are born to die again in the cycle of reincarnation. The veil of Maya is a heavy veil.
Without the Divine Name, life is a cycle of birth and death. Maya, or illusion, is a strong force that can destroy us. Fear of God and detachment can be the boat to cross over.

blocks.scenario: You are tempted by material possessions and worldly pleasures. Do you:

choices.text: Remember the importance of detachment and focus on spiritual growth.
Indulge in the temptations and seek temporary satisfaction.

blocks.why: Remembering detachment and focusing on spiritual growth aligns with the tags of maya, fear, and reincarnation.

blocks.question: What is the cycle we are born into without the Naam?

blocks.text: Detachment can help us navigate the illusions of the world.
Attached to ignorance, people are falling asleep; attached to spiritual wisdom, they awaken. Chant the Name of the Lord, and be carried across.
Ignorance keeps us in darkness, while spiritual wisdom awakens us. Chanting the Divine Name helps us cross over. We should ask for God's Mercy to attach us to His Name.

blocks.scenario: You are struggling to understand a difficult concept. Do you:

choices.text: Seek spiritual wisdom and guidance to awaken your understanding.
Give up and remain in ignorance.

blocks.why: Seeking spiritual wisdom aligns with the tags of gian, naam, and kirpa.

blocks.question: What awakens us from ignorance?

blocks.text: Seeking wisdom and chanting the Name can enlighten us.
The filth of egotism is washed away by joining the Sangat. Joining the Society of the Saints, you shall receive the Sublime Essence of the Lord.

Egotism from past lives can be cleansed by joining the holy congregation. Being in the company of saints allows us to experience the Divine Essence. Without the Sangat, actions are done in egotistical pride.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling proud and arrogant. Do you:

choices.text: Seek the company of humble and devoted people to cleanse your ego.
Continue to indulge in your pride and arrogance.

blocks.why: Seeking the company of humble people aligns with the tags of sangat, haumai, and seva.

blocks.question: What washes away the filth of egotism?

blocks.text: The Sangat can help us cleanse our ego and find humility.
Bow to humble devotees to obtain virtue. Doubts should be removed by worshipping devotees.
Showing respect to humble people brings virtue. Worship devotees and remove any doubts you have.

blocks.scenario: A new person joins your community. They seem different from everyone else. Do you:

choices.text: Treat them with respect and try to learn from them.
Ignore them because they are different.

blocks.why: This aligns with the lesson's emphasis on respecting and learning from devotees, regardless of perceived differences, to gain virtue and remove doubts.

blocks.question: What is obtained by bowing to humble devotees?

blocks.text: Respecting others can bring positive qualities.
Sing God's praises following the Guru's teachings. Through the Guru's wisdom, the mind becomes steady.
By following the Guru's teachings and singing praises, one can find balance. The Guru's wisdom helps to stabilize the mind.

blocks.scenario: You feel overwhelmed by daily tasks. Do you:

choices.text: Take a moment to reflect and find inner peace.
Continue to rush without a break.

blocks.why: This choice reflects the lesson's emphasis on finding balance and a steady mind through spiritual wisdom.

blocks.question: What makes the mind steady?
blocks.answer: The Wisdom of the Guru's Teachings.

blocks.text: Following the Guru's guidance can bring inner peace.
Humble servants who meditate are at peace. The Guru's congregation can carry us across.
Those who meditate with humility find peace. The Guru's community can help us overcome challenges.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling lost and alone. Do you:

choices.text: Seek support from your community.
Isolate yourself and deal with it alone.

blocks.why: This choice aligns with the lesson's emphasis on the importance of the Guru's congregation for support and guidance.

blocks.question: Who finds peace?

blocks.text: Community support can help us through difficult times.
Meditate in all situations, as the True Guru is the Word. Through Guru's Grace, merge in the Naam.
The True Guru is found in the Word, which guides us to liberation. By the Guru's grace, ego is extinguished, and we merge with the Divine.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling stressed about a future event. Do you:

choices.text: Focus on the present moment and meditate.
Worry excessively about the future.

blocks.why: This choice aligns with the lesson's emphasis on meditation and detachment from worries through the Guru's teachings.

blocks.question: What is the True Guru?

blocks.text: Focusing on the present can bring peace.
Humbly surrender to the Guru to seek goodness. Fear of God makes one fearless.
By surrendering to the Guru, one can find goodness. Fear of God leads to fearlessness and purity.

blocks.scenario: You are facing a difficult decision. Do you:

choices.text: Seek guidance from a trusted mentor.
Make the decision impulsively without advice.

blocks.why: This choice aligns with the lesson's emphasis on seeking guidance from the Guru for goodness and overcoming fear.

blocks.question: What makes one fearless?

blocks.text: Seeking guidance can help us make better choices.
Attachment to greed hinders spiritual growth. Through the Guru's teachings, one is dyed in the color of His Love. All merge into the One Creator.
Greed and duality prevent us from experiencing divine love. By connecting with the Guru, we can overcome these obstacles and realize the oneness of all creation.

blocks.scenario: You are tempted to acquire something you don't need. Do you:

choices.text: Reflect on whether it aligns with your values.
Give in to the desire without thinking.

blocks.why: This choice aligns with the lesson's emphasis on overcoming greed and attachment through reflection and connection with the Guru's teachings.

blocks.question: What hinders spiritual growth?

blocks.text: Detachment can lead to inner peace.
The Gurmukh realizes the One Lord and meets Him within. Meeting the True Guru brings absolute peace.
A Gurmukh understands the oneness of the Divine and experiences His presence within. Connecting with the True Guru leads to inner peace and clarity.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling anxious and restless. Do you:

choices.text: Seek guidance from spiritual teachings.
Distract yourself with entertainment.

blocks.why: This choice aligns with the lesson's emphasis on finding peace through the Guru and spiritual understanding.

blocks.question: What brings absolute peace?

blocks.text: Spiritual guidance can bring inner peace.
Instill faith in the Naam through the Guru's Grace. Discipline the mind with the Guru's Shabad.
With the Guru's Grace, develop faith in the Divine Name. Just as an elephant is controlled, the mind can be disciplined by the Guru's teachings.

blocks.scenario: Your mind is wandering and unfocused. Do you:

choices.text: Practice meditation or focus on spiritual teachings.
Let your thoughts drift without direction.

blocks.why: This choice aligns with the lesson's emphasis on disciplining the mind through the Guru's Shabad and spiritual practices.

blocks.question: How is the mind disciplined?
blocks.answer: By the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

blocks.text: Discipline can bring focus and clarity.
The Guru's Shabad is like an antidote to poison. It can help lift us from emotional attachment.
The Guru's Word can protect us from the poisonous effects of Maya. By attuning ourselves to the Lord, we can overcome greed and attachment. The Guru can lift us from sinking in emotional attachment.

blocks.scenario: You feel overwhelmed by wanting the latest gadgets and comparing yourself to others online. Do you:

choices.text: Reflect on the Guru's teachings and focus on inner peace.
Continue browsing online, hoping to find something that will make you feel better.

blocks.why: Reflecting on the Guru's teachings helps to overcome attachment, aligning with the tags.

blocks.question: What can the Guru's Shabad be compared to in this lesson?

blocks.text: The Guru's teachings can help us rise above emotional attachment.
The world is a game, and we should seek the profit of Naam. Acting in egotism leads to suffering.

The world is like a dream. We should earn the profit of Naam by following the Guru's teachings. Acting in egotism leads to collecting sin, and we must face the consequences of our actions. Gather the wealth of the Lord's Name and give abundantly.

blocks.scenario: You are offered a promotion at work, but it requires you to take credit for a colleague's work. Do you:

choices.text: Politely decline and continue to work honestly.
Accept the promotion and take credit for the work.

blocks.why: Declining the promotion avoids egotism and aligns with earning the profit of Naam, relating to the tags.

blocks.question: What should we gather according to this lesson?
blocks.answer: The Wealth of the Lord's Name.

blocks.text: Following the Guru's teachings and avoiding ego can lead to honor.
The wealth of the Lord's Name is within the heart and found in the Guru's Sanctuary. Seek the Sanctuary of the True Guru and meditate.
The Lord's Name is deep within. By seeking the Guru's Sanctuary and meditating, we can find it. God is kind and compassionate. The Guru is like a philosopher's stone, transforming us.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling lost and unsure of what to do next in your life. Do you:

choices.text: Seek guidance from a trusted mentor or spiritual leader.
Isolate yourself and try to figure it out on your own.

blocks.why: Seeking guidance aligns with seeking the Sanctuary of the True Guru, connecting to the tags.

blocks.question: Where is the wealth of the Lord's Name found?
blocks.answer: Within the heart and in the Guru's Sanctuary.

blocks.text: Seeking the Guru's Sanctuary can help us find inner peace and guidance.
The Word of the True Guru is sublime. Entering the Sanctuary of the True Guru provides protection.
Through the Guru's Word, we can obtain Ambrosial Nectar. The Sanctuary of the True Guru is pleasing and pure. God protects those who enter the Guru's Sanctuary.

blocks.scenario: You are facing a difficult challenge at work and feel overwhelmed. Do you:

choices.text: Reflect on the Guru's teachings and seek inner strength.
Give up and avoid the challenge.

blocks.why: Reflecting on the Guru's teachings aligns with seeking protection through the Guru's Word, relating to the tags.

blocks.question: What is obtained through the Guru's Word?

blocks.text: The Guru's Word and Sanctuary offer protection and strength.
Meditate on the Guru's teachings to unite with the Lord. The Guru's Word is the Sound-current.
Meditating on the Guru's wisdom unites us with the Lord. The Guru's Word is the Sound-current and wisdom. The waves of greed are like packs of dogs, and the poison of Maya sticks to the body.

blocks.scenario: You are tempted to gossip about a friend to gain popularity. Do you:

choices.text: Resist the temptation and speak kindly of your friend.
Join in the gossip to gain acceptance.

blocks.why: Resisting temptation aligns with meditating on the Guru's teachings and avoiding Maya, connecting to the tags.

blocks.question: What is the Guru's Word?

The Lord's Name saves the world; join the Sangat and meditate on it. Working for Maya is useless. By meditating on the Lord and renouncing pride and attachment, we can find salvation.

blocks.scenario: You are invited to a gathering where people are engaging in negative and harmful behaviors. Do you:

Attend the gathering and participate in the negative behaviors.

blocks.why: Seeking positive company aligns with joining the Sangat and detaching from negativity, connecting to the tags.

blocks.question: What should we join according to this lesson?

blocks.text: Joining the Sangat and meditating on the Naam can lead to salvation.
Meditate on the Lord of the World. This brings the merits of perfect service.

blocks.scenario: You have a busy day but notice a neighbor struggling to carry groceries. Do you:

choices.text: Offer to help them carry the groceries.
Continue with your day, assuming someone else will help.

blocks.why: Offering help aligns with perfect service and seeking grace, connecting to the tags.

blocks.question: What does meditating on the Lord bring?
blocks.answer: The merits of chanting, meditation, and perfect service.

blocks.text: Meditating on the Lord and serving others can lead to a fruitful life.
Meditating on Govind brings honor. The True Congregation is blessed; join them and chant the Lord's Name.
Meditating on Govind through the Guru's teachings brings honor. The True Congregation is blessed; join them and chant the Lord's Name. By chanting the Lord's Name, all sins are washed away.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling disconnected from your community. Do you:

choices.text: Seek out opportunities to connect with others in a positive and supportive environment.
Continue to isolate yourself and avoid social interaction.

blocks.why: Seeking connection aligns with joining the True Congregation and chanting the Lord's Name, connecting to the tags.

blocks.question: What is washed away by chanting the Lord's Name?

The Lord's will prevails, and He is endless. By praising the Lord, your body and mind find peace. Meditating on the Guru's Shabad brings desired fruits and washes away sins.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling anxious about an upcoming presentation at work.

choices.text: Take a few moments to meditate and focus on the Lord's Name.
Spend the time rehearsing your presentation over and over.

blocks.why: Meditating on the Lord's Name can bring peace and help one recognize the divine within, aligning with the lesson's tags.

blocks.question: According to this passage, what happens when you praise the Lord?
blocks.answer: Your body and mind are cooled and soothed.

blocks.text: Remember, the Lord's mercy and will are ever-present; find peace through meditation.

The Lord prevails in the Sangat, and meditating on the Name eradicates egotism. Remembering the Lord brings radiance in the Court of the True Lord. The Creator pervades all places and links us to the Guru's teachings.

blocks.scenario: You are feeling isolated and overwhelmed by negative thoughts.

choices.text: Join a local religious gathering to reflect on teachings and meditate with others.
Stay home and try to distract yourself with entertainment.
